data.jd_text:
**Company Description**
 Do you want to shape the world of tomorrow and work on innovative projects? Then you're a good fit for us! We are a global engineering group with 15,000 employees and 140 locations worldwide. With our services, we are driving the topics of energy efficiency, climate protection and decarbonization and developing tech industries into new dimensions.
   

  

 The world of SEGULA Technologies Experts revolves around industries such as automotive, software, energy and life sciences. As an independent player, we support OEMs and suppliers with personal engineering services. Take advantage of new opportunities and take on exciting tasks and attractive positions with direct customer assignment.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Department:** 
 Finance / Project Finance / Corporate Development
   

  

**Seniority Level:** 
 Director
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Project Finance Director** 
 to lead the financial structuring, modelling, valuation, and transaction support of major development projects across the Near and Middle East region.
   

  

**Important:** 
 This is a
 **Project Finance Director** 
 role focused on
 **development project financing, M\&A transactions, financial structuring, valuation, investment committee preparation, and bankability analysis** 
 . It is
 **not** 
 a CFO, Head of Finance, or operational finance management position.
   

  

 The selected candidate will act as a key financial advisor to Business Development and Investment teams and will support projects from origination and tender stage through financial close, acquisition, development, and handover to operational teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Financial Modelling \& Valuation
   

  

 Develop comprehensive financial models for new development projects, acquisitions, greenfield and brownfield opportunities, and M\&A transactions.
   

  

 Perform detailed valuation analysis and assess project returns in line with applicable accounting and investment standards.
   

  

 Challenge cost assumptions, revenue forecasts, financing assumptions, and business plans for tender submissions and investment decisions.
   

  

 Support impairment testing, long\-term planning exercises, and financial analysis for growth projects.
   

  

 Risk Analysis \& Financial Structuring
   

  

 Identify, analyze, and quantify key project risks, including construction, operational, credit, currency, interest rate, contractual, and financing risks.
   

  

 Review contracts from a financial perspective and prepare risk matrices to support project decision\-making.
   

  

 Support bond requirements, guarantees, insurance considerations, and other financial risk mitigation mechanisms.
   

  

 Structure project financing solutions in coordination with banks, financial institutions, external advisors, and internal stakeholders.
   

  

 Transaction Support \& M\&A
   

  

 Lead financial workstreams for M\&A transactions, including due diligence, valuation, transaction modelling, financial planning, closing support, and integration.
   

  

 Review and optimize financial and legal structures, including tax, debt, equity, and project company considerations.
   

  

 Support the preparation and optimization of financial offers during prequalification, tender, and negotiation stages.
   

  

 Coordinate financial, technical, legal, and tax due diligence activities to ensure bankability and investment readiness.
   

  

 Documentation \& Governance
   

  

 Review and contribute to finance\-related provisions in contractual documentation, including share purchase agreements, shareholders’ agreements, service agreements, and financing documents.
   

  

 Prepare investment memorandums, financial presentations, and decision\-support materials for senior management and investment committees.
   

  

 Ensure projects comply with internal investment criteria, governance standards, and approval processes.
   

  

 Support smooth transition from development phase to project CFO or operational finance teams after award or financial close.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Work closely with Business Development, Legal, Tax, Accounting, Treasury, Investment Control, M\&A, Corporate Development, Insurance, and regional management teams.
   

  

 Liaise with external advisors, auditors, banks, financial institutions, and other transaction stakeholders.
   

  

 Participate in financial negotiations with partners, lenders, investors, and clients.
   

  

 Translate complex financial concepts into clear recommendations for non\-finance stakeholders.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
   

  

 MBA, CFA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.
   

  

 Minimum
 **10 years of progressive experience** 
 in corporate finance, project finance, infrastructure finance, M\&A, investment banking, transaction services, or financial advisory.
   

  

 Strong experience in financial modelling, valuation, project finance structuring, and investment analysis.
   

  

 Solid understanding of IFRS and the application of accounting standards to complex transactions.
   

  

 Experience with bankable project finance structures, debt financing arrangements, and non\-recourse or limited\-recourse financing.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of corporate tax structures, business contracts, shareholder arrangements, and financing documentation.
   

  

 Ability to coordinate financial, legal, technical, tax, and commercial due diligence workstreams.
   

  

 Experience in infrastructure, utilities, water, energy, environmental services, PPP, or concession\-based projects is highly desirable.
   

  

 Familiarity with Near and Middle East markets is preferred.
   

  

 Fluency in English is required. Arabic and/or French would be an advantage.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 Advanced financial modelling and valuation skills.
   

  

 Strong analytical, strategic, and problem\-solving mindset.
   

  

 Excellent understanding of project finance, M\&A, risk analysis, and investment governance.
   

  

 Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Ability to defend financial assumptions and investment recommendations with confidence.
   

  

 Excellent communication and presentation skills.
   

  

 High level of financial rigor, attention to detail, and accuracy.
   

  

 Ability to manage multiple complex projects under tight deadlines.
   

  

 Proactive, autonomous, resilient, and comfortable working in fast\-paced environments.
   

  

 Strong cultural sensitivity and ability to work across functions, countries, and seniority levels.
   

  

**Preferred Background**
 Candidates coming from the following backgrounds will be strongly considered:
   

  

 Investment Banking
   

  

 Project Finance Advisory
   

  

 Infrastructure Finance
   

  

 Transaction Services / Deal Advisory
   

  

 Corporate Development
   

  

 M\&A
   

  

 PPP / Concession Projects
   

  

 Utilities / Water / Energy / Environmental Infrastructure
   

  

 Multinational Corporate Finance teams focused on development projects
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Important Note for Applicants**
 This position is specifically focused on
 **project finance, financial structuring, M\&A transactions, valuation, bankability, and development project financing** 
 .
   

  

 Candidates with only traditional accounting, financial control, FP\&A, or operational CFO experience may not be suitable unless they have strong hands\-on exposure to project finance and transaction structuring.
   

  

**Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted**

data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



**Job Purpose** 




 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Industrials \& Manufacturing segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 



* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.



  





**Business Origination** 



* Originate new business opportunities with target clients across relevant banking products in full compliance with applicable internal policies and the Target Market and Risk Acceptance Criteria.
* Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Negotiate and develop Term Sheet, mandate letter pitch deck etc. for new transactions in close co\-ordination with product teams. Ability work on financial models, and conduct evaluations to support deal structuring and client presentations. Strong understanding of LMA documentation protocols would be a plus.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Collaborate and work closely with FAB International Branches to increase client wallet share, depth of relationship and X\-sell opportunities with key global client relationships.
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions
* RORAC \[Return on Risk Adjusted Capital] calculation, drafting and submission of CAC note to Capital Allocation Committee in order to meet mandated return thresholds.
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to acceptable parameters set by the
* Bank's management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate new business.
* Maintain up‑to‑date market competitor, regulatory and industry and proactively update account plans as required
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Client Relationship Management** 



* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Group Key Account Plans \[GKAPS] for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* ESG: Liaising with clients for collection of necessary data, info for preparation of ESG rating note in compliance with FAB’s ESG policy \& SOPs and its subsequent renewals at specified intervals.
* Support the timely completion of annual/periodic credit facility reviews the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit policy to balancing earnings with prudent risk management and potential credit downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain internal controls in line with group credit policy i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from client services, CAD (as applicable).
* Achieve high degree of customer satisfaction reflected in NPS score and annual client survey reports.
* Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with new to bank clients



  





**Collaboration** 



* Align with Industrials \& Manufacturing team as well as other product and coverage verticals to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop business proposition strategy, including competitive analysis, targeted client segmentation, service delivery and customer experience model, internal \& external campaigns and ensure alignment with other Products proposition covering Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, and collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 



* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions enabling work is .executed in a controlled, consistent manner and compliant.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis and proactively escalate as appropriate
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit rating of the portfolio on an ongoing basis
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, standard
* Leadership: Act as Role Model for the entire Industrials \& Manufacturing group and demonstrating the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and leadership behaviour.
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to support career progression, skill upgradation and robust short \& long term succession plans.
* Foster a high‑performance culture, driving strong employee engagement, accountability, and a results‑oriented mindset across the team. Encourage ownership and accountability by assigning responsibilities aligned with individual capabilities and development objectives.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Champion Learning and development ,attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure ongoing skill enhancement, development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Minimum Qualification:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in finance, math or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.



  





**Minimum Experience** 



* 15\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes** 



* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyse and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

data.jd_text:
KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented
 **Director \- Project Controls** 
 to join our PMCM Division based in
 **Dubai OR Abu Dhabi, UAE** 
 . This position is responsible for establishing, managing and continuously improving KEO's project controls framework across GCC\-based projects. This core\-office position ensures the effective planning, scheduling, resourcing, progress monitoring, reporting, and document control of multi\-disciplinary consultancy projects.
 



  





 The role provides strategic oversight and governance to ensure that projects are delivered on time, within approved schedules, and in alignment with contractual, corporate, and client requirements. The Director will act as a trusted advisor to project directors and senior leadership, supporting informed decision\-making through accurate data, forecasting, and performance analysis.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  




* Establish and maintain corporate standards, procedures, and best practices for project planning and scheduling across all projects.
* Provide strategic oversight of project baseline schedules, ensuring alignment with contracts, scopes, and milestones.
* Review, validate, and approve project schedules, recovery plans, and revised programs.
* Ensure integration of schedules across disciplines, phases, and stakeholders.
* Monitor schedule performance, identify critical path risks, and drive mitigation strategies in collaboration with project teams.
* Oversee project performance measurement systems, including progress tracking, earned value management, and KPI reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate preparation of executive dashboards, monthly reports, and schedule risk assessments.
* Analyze trends, variances, and forecast impacts on project timelines and advise leadership on corrective actions.
* Support senior management with data\-driven insights for strategic planning and decision\-making.
* Lead the development and management of resource planning and forecasting across all projects in GCC.
* Ensure optimal allocation of personnel in line with project requirements, skills, availability, and workload.
* Work closely with HR, Operations, and Project Directors to address resource gaps, mobilization planning, and recruitment forecasting.
* Monitor utilization rates and proactively manage capacity planning to support business objectives.
* Support succession planning and development of project controls talent within the organization.



  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include minimum 15 years work experience partnered with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Constructuon Management , Project Management or related discipline.
 



  





 Chartered status or Professional Membership will be viewed favourably.
 



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

 Supervise and provide inputs in the preparation of timely and accurate sub\-departmental statements and reports (esp. the Underwriting \& Sales Report) to meet FAB’s and departmental requirements, policies, and standards.

**Knowledge \& Experience:** 



* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in managing and facilitating real estate loans business in a banking environment.
* In\-depth knowledge of the Real Estate sector, and FAB’s products and business strategies.
* Deep understanding and working knowledge of international real estate debt markets and syndicated loan \& debt capital market.



**Skills:** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand financing structures based on the current \& expected market conditions.
* Ability to multi\-task with strong credit, structuring and LMA documentation, expertise required.
* Strong negotiating skills and ability to exercise good judgment which balances needs of client, investors and FAB.
* Solid understanding of accounting and financial statements.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Ability to build and develop strategic relationships.

data.jd_text:
**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.
* Liaise with Ministries of Education and local education councils.
* Develop data\-driven, multi\-year enrollment projection scenarios to establish capacity parameters and budgetary requirements.
* Monitor and assess the growth of the external student sponsorship program and strengthen relationships with sponsoring organizations.
* Represent the university at media events and on\- and off\-campus recruitment functions.
* Develop a recruitment and new\-student communications plan, guiding prospects from initial inquiry through matriculation.
* Develop and implement, in consultation with the recruitment team, an annual comprehensive recruitment campaign plan.
* Co\-manage, with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department, the development of communication plans and the implementation of promotional tools for recruitment campaigns (e.g., social media, advertising).
* Engage colleges/schools, faculty, alumni, and various AUS departments in recruitment efforts to achieve enrollment goals.
* Establish partnership agreements with select high schools locally and internationally to attract highly qualified applicants.
* Lead the integration of automation and artificial intelligence solutions to enhance enrollment operations, improve applicant experience, increase efficiency, and transition key processes from manual to data\-driven digital workflows.


**Qualifications And Skills Required**
* Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of the higher education landscape, including emerging trends, regulatory frameworks, and best practices in enrollment management.
* Solid background in developing and implementing admissions policies, academic credential evaluation standards, and related governance frameworks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.


**How To Apply**
* Interested applicants should fill out the form.
* AUS alumni are encouraged to apply. Applicants who do not meet specified requirements will not be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
* AUS is an equal opportunity employer. We adhere to a policy of making employment decisions without regard to race, color, age, gender, religion, national origin, disability or marital status. Opportunities for employment are based solely upon one’s qualifications.

 Lulu is one of the most trusted and expansive retail brands in the Middle East, with operations across 6 GCC countries—UAE, KSA, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, and Kuwait. We serve millions of customers every week through a powerful combination of physical and digital touchpoints.
 







 Our store network spans over 250 outlets, including:

 Large\-format stores offering full grocery and department store assortments.
 



**• Express Stores (\~110\+):** 
 Neighbourhood essentials with curated ranges.

 High\-frequency top\-up stores designed for convenience.
 







 With this extensive offline footprint, we're now on a mission to build the most loved ecommerce platform in the region, integrating our physical scale with seamless digital capabilities.
 







 But we’re not solving only for grocery.
 







 Our digital platform will power multiple verticals including fashion, electronics, mobiles, household goods, and more. We’re also preparing for the next generation of store formats—from express stores to experiential showrooms.
 







 Lulu Digital aims to become the everyday shopping platform for millions—offering scheduled and on\- demand delivery, cross category convenience, personalization at scale, and regional relevance at global standards.

 At LuLu, we operate one of the largest retails and omnichannel ecosystems in the region, serving millions of customers across both physical stores and digital platforms.  , you will lead the design, development, and execution of initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency across LuLu’s e\-commerce and support ecosystem.  To meet the expectations of Clients, for whom he/
data.jd_text:
**1 Mission** 




 The Project Director is in charge of the complete implementation of the management strategy for projects under his/her responsibility, and for which he/she has the support of resources either inside or outside the affiliate.
 



 To meet the expectations of Clients, for whom he/she is the direct and key contact, the Project Director supervises architectural and technical studies. Every decision of design modification leading to financial consequences is taken by him/her. At the same time, he/she guarantees the economic balance of the project and the respect of Quality principles. He/she also deals with all the contractual issues between Artelia Airports and its clients.
 



 In the management of studies, the Project Director supervises the project teams made available. He/she draws up and manages design contracts entered into with designers outside Artelia Airports and guarantees their functioning. With the support of the functional resources of affiliates, he/she defines the subcontracting strategy, then drafts and manages the subcontracting contracts necessary to project implementation.
 



 He/She contributes to the definition of the affiliate’s strategic focus.
 



  





**2 Line and Staff Relations** 




 The role will directly report to the Director, Production and Operations and will work in close collaboration with the following teams:
 



  




* ARTELIA AIRPORTS Staff
* Design Manager
* Contract Administrator
* Director of Tendering and Consulting
* Resident Engineer
* Planning Engineer
* Design Team, all disciplines
* Supervision Team at site
* QA/QC
* HSE
* External Collaborators
* Client Representatives
* Sub\-Consultants
* Contractors / Sub\-Contractors



  





**3 Key Responsibilities** 




 Ensures the management of signed contracts
 


* He/she negotiates the technical and financial approach to projects in his/her portfolio (with Management assisted by the Business Development)
* He/she defines the progress of the project (consistent with the Client’s specifications) and the recourse to outside resources (subcontracting)
* He/she defines the technical, budgetary and financial resources necessary
* He/she defines resources to be implemented and monitoring indicators
* He/she monitors Management’s continuous and adequate information as far as finance, technical choices and deadlines are concerned, in providing the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations with the data necessary to their audit (Control Panels and performance indicators)
* He/she uses feedback information from the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations in the management of his project
* He/she supervises studies and manages teams:
* breaks specifications down into study objectives and study team needs
* establishes the monitoring indicators of studies to be carried out
* directs, focuses and coordinates the group of project contributors, i.e. :
* is in charge of teams under his/her direct responsibility.
* focuses and coordinates the work of outside designers.
* coordinates the work of teams, including those teams working on the site.
* monitors subcontractors.
* monitors Artelia Airports spending and manages it in relation to projected financial schedules.
* guarantees project / Client program appropriateness (functional and technical aspects, study and finishing deadlines and target costs)
* monitors Quality and the respect of project deadlines through continuous dialogue with outside designers (optimization of economic choices, project consistency)
* contributes to the concrete production of studies
* updates the Director of Operations and Production on technical bases
* He/she manages Client relations:
* conducts the technical dialogue on the project with the Client (technical choices, functionality)
* validates the various stages of the project with the Client
* conducts the closure of services due under contracts entered into with Clients
* implements the contracts entered into with the Clients
* monitors the deadlines, quality and costs follow\-up
* is responsible to report to executive management any changes of the Artelia Airports contract
* prepares, with support from the Business Development Manager, the technical and financial files for possible complaints (follow\-up letters etc…)
* advises the Business Development Manager and Executive Management in terms on market opportunities when required
* He/she updates load plans by:
* Defining staff needs according to their skills
* Allowing or denying additional missions
* Accepting vacations
* Managing all the means needed for his project
* Contractors:
* signs all the instructions to the contractor including:
* notice to proceed and eventually to stop the works on site
* technical variation orders
* financial variation orders
* schedule variation orders
* penalty orders for delay
* validates all the contractors’ submissions and quality control plans produced by contractors or he/she can delegate such responsibility.
* He/she follows the project for Artelia Airports by :
* Following its spending and invoices
* Approving the schedule for the project
* Approving the missions and reporting it to the Managing Director
* Within the framework of his activities, the Project Director contributes, in a relevant manner, to the fulfillment of Quality objectives.



  





**4 Profile Specifications – Minimum Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in airport management, planning, aviation science, or engineering.
* 15 years’ experience minimum on large size construction projects or similar transportation projects in a similar position, with a minimum of 3 airport projects references strongly preferred \- both design and site supervision.
* Thorough knowledge of engineering design, construction estimating, facility operation, project budgeting and scheduling.
* Demonstrated knowledge of capital planning and assessment, cost\-benefit analysis, planning and evaluation, and risk management protocols
* Experienced in Project Management and FIDIC contracts
* Experience in ICAO and IATA regulations is a plus
* Excellent presentation, coordination and leadership skills
* Knowledge of local laws and regulations, international codes and standards
* Fluent in English; reading, writing and speaking
* Proficiency in the use of standard Microsoft Office products, Primavera (Oracle’s Project Management software) or MS Project.
* Eligibility for frequent travels to be expected.
* SoE membership and AUH Engineering license are mandatory or proven eligibility



  





***Note to external recruiters:***
*Please note that Artelia Airports does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, Artelia Airports will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, Artelia Airports explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Artelia Airports and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Artelia Airports as a result of the referral or through other means.*

**About Astrazeneca**
 AstraZeneca is a global, science\-led, patient\-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 AstraZeneca is accelerating the expansion of our geographical footprint in rare diseases following the acquisition of Alexion in 2021\. Rare diseases is a high\-growth therapy area with rapid innovation and significant unmet medical need. Over 7,000 rare diseases are known today – yet less than 1% of them have an approved treatment.
   

  

 The Rare Disease Medical Advisor (RD MA) is responsible for driving the execution of medical activities across the Gulf region. The role ensures the delivery of scientific engagement, medical education, evidence support, and insight generation in alignment with the TA medical plan.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the Associate Medical Director, Hematology/Nephrology/Transplant (HNT), Gulf, you will act as a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, centers of excellence, and cross\-functional teams — ensuring that science, ethics, and patient needs remain at the core of every initiative.
   

  

 This role requires strong therapeutic knowledge, scientific acumen, and the ability to connect insights from the field to the broader business and medical strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Field Medical Excellence**
* Execute the Medical Affairs Plan in alignment with guidance from the Associate Medical Director and cross\-functional brand teams.
* Deliver scientific exchange with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and decision\-makers to support appropriate use of AstraZeneca’s rare disease medicines.
* Drive the implementation of disease education, diagnostic initiatives, and patient identification projects in collaboration with cross\-functional partners.
* Support the rollout of launch readiness and lifecycle management activities for assigned indications.


**Scientific Engagement and External Collaboration**
* Build strong peer\-to\-peer relationships with Key External Experts (KEEs), academic partners, and referral centers to advance medical understanding and patient management.
* Organize, support, and present in scientific meetings, advisory boards, and symposia as a subject\-matter expert.
* Actively contribute to speaker training, CME partnerships, and scientific programs aligned with medical strategy.
* Gather and communicate scientific insights that inform the local strategy and identify new opportunities for data generation or access improvement.


**Evidence Generation and Data Dissemination**
* Support the planning and operationalization of local studies, registries, and Investigator\-Initiated Studies in coordination with the Associate Medical Director, Evidence Generation and Clinical Operations teams.
* Contribute to the development and review of scientific materials, ensuring accuracy, balance, and compliance.
* Disseminate emerging clinical data to internal and external stakeholders in an ethical and scientifically objective manner.


**Cross\-Functional Medical Support**
* Partner closely with Market Access, Commercial, and Regulatory teams to ensure scientific and medical integrity in all activities.
* Provide field\-based medical input to access dossiers, value communication, and payer interactions where appropriate.
* Deliver medical training and scientific support to internal colleagues (e.g., sales, market access, or diagnostics teams).
* Support the implementation of early access and expanded access programs under guidance from the Associate Medical Director.


**Compliance and Medical Governance**
* Ensure all activities comply with AstraZeneca ethical standards, SOPs, and local regulatory frameworks.
* Maintain up\-to\-date training on Ethical Interactions, GPEI, and Rare Disease policies.
* Accurately document medical interactions, adverse event reports, and insights in compliance systems.


**Essential For The Role**
* Advanced degree (MD, PharmD, or PhD preferred; MSc in Medical or Biological Sciences considered with strong experience).
* Minimum 4 years of experience in Medical Affairs or related scientific roles, ideally within rare diseases or specialty.
* Proven ability to translate scientific data into clinical value and communicate with scientific credibility.
* Strong presentation, analytical, and project coordination skills.
* Deep understanding of Gulf healthcare systems, referral patterns, and access pathways.
* Fluency in English (Arabic preferred).
* Willingness to travel across the Gulf (50\-60%).


**Desirable For The Role**
* Experience supporting product launches or early\-access programs.
* Active contribution to medical education or registry collaborations.
* Familiarity with real\-world data, market access dossiers, or diagnostic collaborations.
* Demonstrated ability to work in cross\-functional teams with both medical and commercial stakeholders.


**Why AstraZeneca?**
 At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
   

  

**So, what’s next?**
* Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
* Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.


**Where can I find out more?**
* Our Social Media, Follow AstraZeneca on LinkedIn
* Follow AstraZeneca on Instagram
* Follow AstraZeneca on Facebook


**Date Posted**
 29\-Apr\-2026
   

  

**Closing Date**
 10\-May\-2026
   

  

 AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry\-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non\-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction
   

  

* Work closely with Engg, Manufacturing systems manager, supply chain and purchasing on new product industrialisation in a timely manner


 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness

 The Plant Director operates within a manufacturing environment serving utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across the Middle East and export markets. The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the vision of Dubai’s leadership, to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, and positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many future\-facing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, and more.
 



  





 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





**The UAE World Economic Forum’sCentre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution** 




 The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE (C4IR UAE) is a collaboration between the Dubai Future Foundation and the World Economic Forum and is the first global affiliate centre having opened in April 2019\.
 



  





 The UAE Centre is hosted by the Dubai Future Foundation and serves as a global public\-private platform for the collaborative development of technology governance and policy research to offer global visibility to 4IR activities in the UAE. As such, each project portfolio works on a global scale, in collaboration with the World Economic Forum teams and C4IR network, and is tailored to the local ecosystem.
 



  





 Previous and ongoing products of the C4IR have included reports on UAE blockchain use cases and implementation toolkit, the AI procurement toolkit, tokenization and digital assets report and proof of concept, a C\-Suite toolkit for AI. The Centre has also hosted Smart Toys Award and has recently published on the impact of AI on creative economies. All published work is available on www.c4ir.ae
 



  





 The C4IR network is a focal point within the international community for multi\-stakeholder dialogue and concrete cooperation on governance challenges and opportunities presented by advanced technologies from the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR).
 



  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 The Centre interfaces with senior stakeholders of local and federal government entities across the UAE to support, shape and influence policies associated with 4IR technologies and their impacts on the UAE’s economy and society.
 



  





 The Programme Head will regularly interface with local and regional stakeholders, across the UAE government, along with the CEO and Deputy CEO of the Dubai Future Foundation. She or he will also provide insight and updates to the Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Applications. In addition, the Programme Head will manage the Centre’s Steering Committee and interface regularly with the WEF Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution in San Francisco.
 



  





**Programme Head** 




 The C4IR UAE Programme Head will be responsible for leading the Centre, including developing and implementing the annual strategy, and managing the plans, workflows, budgets, and priorities of the Centre. The Programme Head will also play an active role within the DFF structure and will provide insight and expertise when required.
 



  





**Responsibilities \& Reporting Lines** 




 The Programme Head reports directly to the Executive Director of the Dubai Future Institute within DFF.
 



  





 The Programme Head is a complex and articulated position that holds overall responsibility for managing the Centre, including the following:
 



  





 • Ensure the Centre achieves the highest possible visibility and impact through high\-quality products and key activities.
 



 • Ensure the Centre maintains a healthy pipeline of high\-impact products which shall include research reports, policy reports, proof of conceptwork, development of policy proposals, as well as a range of public\-facing engagements.
 



 • Manage internal and external collaborators, including contractors and network members, of varying seniority, to deliver the expected products.
 



 • Sets clear, ambitious targets, activities and workflows for the team. Provides guidance on associated resources required.
 



 • Will support as needed the core activities of DFF.
 



 • Represent the Centre and DFF at internal, national, and international events.
 



  





**Project Management** 




 • You are responsible for leading the full project cycle including managing budgets, project milestones, coaching and developing the team, setting objectives, monitoring and tracking and post\-project reporting.
 



 • You will brainstorm and work with the team to creatively and critically assess ideas, and evaluate processes that could be re\-engineered to identify future projects for delivery.
 



 • You will delegate and assign tasks to the team to ensure the delivery of project deadlines.
 



 • You will need to openly communicate with team members to ensure that all projects are running smoothly and regularly feed back to the Executive Director – Future, Foresight and Imagination on operations and administration.
 



 Third Party Relationships
 



 • You will be responsible for creating a network of expertise, bringing in new connections with experts that will benefit the organisation and building regional and international relationships.
 



 • You will work closely with other departments and entities to understand, analyse their needs and develop strategic content.
 



 • You will work closely with the Communications team to provide high\-level advice on how to activate research, long\-term planning, allocation resources for projects.
 



 • You will be responsible for initiating and maintaining long\-term relationships with other Dubai Future Foundation/Centre partners while actively looking for ways to collaborate supporting them.
 



  





**Why is this role important?** 




 To achieve the biggest impact you will need to affirm the Centre’s role as a convenor of stakeholders in the 4IR space, inform and shape policy, and support the establishment of the centre as a regional beacon for producing high quality research and action, and ensure the Centre is top\-of\-mind among top decision\-makers in Dubai and the UAE.
 



  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





 The Centre Head will have the opportunity to participate in / present at international meetings and gain visibility. These may include participation at the WEF annual meeting in Davos, Global Technology Retreats and other engagements.
 



  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?**

data.jd_text:
Welcome to
 **MultiBank Group** 
 , a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting\-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.
 







 Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18\+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.
 



  





**mb.io** 
 is the regulated cryptocurrency exchange under MultiBank Group, offering a user\-friendly platform for instant, secure trading including Bitcoin, Ethereum and more. As we expand our offerings in the cryptocurrency space, we are looking for a
 **Director of Digital Asset Trading \& Exchange Operations** 
 to join the team.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are seeking a senior crypto trading leader to build, lead, and scale a new chapter in our digital asset trading capabilities. This is a strategic and hands\-on role responsible for shaping and advancing the firm’s crypto trading, liquidity, exchange infrastructure, and derivatives capabilities. The role spans
 **OTC, perpetuals, funding logic, market making, liquidity sourcing, hedging, and market structure design** 
 , while also playing an important part in the strategy surrounding token\-related initiatives, exchange engagement, and broader platform growth.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of
 **trading leadership, derivatives expertise, liquidity and market\-making experience, token exposure, and operational depth** 
 . They should understand how to build and scale a crypto trading function that is commercially effective, technically sound, and aligned with a more structured and institutional operating environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Trading Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Lead and scale the crypto trading function across Spot, Derivatives, OTC, and Market Making.
* Define and execute the overall trading strategy in alignment with the company’s growth plans, platform roadmap, and commercial objectives.
* Take ownership of the trading desk’s performance, operating model, and long\-term capability buildout.
* Develop a clear framework for how the business prices risk, sources liquidity, manages execution, and supports product growth.



  





**Derivatives, OTC \& Pricing** 



* Lead the design and launch of the derivatives trading capability from the ground up, including perpetual products, funding logic, hedging frameworks, and exposure management — this is a greenfield build requiring someone who has stood up a derivatives desk before.
* Lead the development of OTC pricing and execution frameworks, including liquidity sourcing, cross\-venue hedging logic, and real\-time pricing across crypto and fiat pairs.
* Ensure pricing, execution, and risk systems reflect actual market behaviour and support sustainable commercial performance.
* Improve the desk’s ability to manage complex market conditions, funding dynamics, and non\-linear risk.



  





**Market Making, Liquidity \& Market Structure** 



* Design and oversee
 **market\-making strategies** 
 to optimise liquidity, spreads, order book depth, and execution efficiency.
* Define and execute
 **liquidity strategy across exchanges and providers** 
 , improving access, reducing slippage, and enhancing execution quality.
* Shape
 **market structure, execution workflows, and venue strategy** 
 to support client flow and platform growth.
* Develop frameworks to manage
 **flow dynamics, adverse selection, and client behaviour** 
 effectively.
* Manage liquidity across
 **CEX and DEX environments (including AMMs)** 
 , optimising execution in both off\-chain and on\-chain markets.
* Oversee integration with
 **custodial providers (e.g. Fireblocks)** 
 , addressing latency, settlement, and operational coordination.
* Drive
 **end\-to\-end latency optimisation** 
 across order routing, signing, and on\-chain settlement.
* Maintain
 **tight spreads and consistent market depth across venues** 
 , managing fragmented liquidity and multi\-exchange listings.



  





**Token Strategy \& Exchange Engagement** 



* Lead token trading and liquidity strategy, including managing simultaneous listings across multiple Tier 1 CEXs, coordinating with exchange listing teams, meeting liquidity requirements, and managing launch windows and post\-listing market support.
* Manage cross\-exchange price consistency, arbitrage mitigation, and unified order book strategy to minimise price discrepancies and adverse arbitrage pressure when the token is live on multiple venues.
* Work closely with relevant stakeholders on exchange relationships, listing processes, and ongoing liquidity support across key venues.
* Ensure token and exchange strategy are underpinned by strong compliance awareness, including wash trading monitoring, market manipulation prevention, and adherence to exchange\-specific listing rules and regulatory requirements.



  





**Spot Platform \& Exchange Infrastructure** 



* Oversee spot trading pair selection, curation, and lifecycle management on the MBIO platform, ensuring pairs are commercially viable and supported by adequate liquidity.
* Bring hands\-on experience with
 **matching engine architecture, order book design, and trade settlement workflows** 
 , working with technology teams to deliver best\-in\-class execution and liquidity on the platform.
* Optimise on\-platform settlement processes and ensure seamless integration between the matching engine, custodial layer, and external liquidity sources.



  





**Risk, Governance \& Infrastructure** 



* Own risk management across trading books, liquidity operations, token\-related exposure, and counterparty activity.
* Build robust controls around inventory, hedging, funding, execution, liquidity, and operational escalation.
* Partner with technology teams on execution tools, APIs, pricing systems, automation, and trading infrastructure.
* Ensure that trading activity operates within a strong governance and compliance framework suitable for a serious and growing platform.



  





**Cross\-functional Leadership** 



* Work closely with Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and senior management to align trading strategy with business objectives.
* Act as the senior internal owner for all matters related to trading logic, liquidity architecture, market structure, and execution design.
* Support decisions that sit across commercial strategy and trading reality, ensuring the platform is built in a way that is both scalable and market\-relevant.



  





**Reporting \& Senior Management Communication**

**Contracts Specialist \- Middle East Region** 
 \- 100% (m/f)
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring solid experience in contracts administration and management within the design engineering, project management consultancy (PMC), or construction industry. Reporting to the Regional Contracts Director, the Contracts Specialist will play a key supporting role in safeguarding the Company's interests across its Middle East portfolio by administering contracts, monitoring compliance with regional regulations, and assisting on contractual and commercial risk matters. With strong attention to detail, sound judgement, and a collaborative approach, the candidate will support project teams, business development, and senior management in achieving successful project and corporate outcomes
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Familiarity with regional commercial, civil, and labour laws across the Middle East (e.g. UAE Federal laws and free\-zone regimes, KSA Government Tenders and Procurement Law and its Implementing Regulations) and with the regulatory environment for engineering consultancies.
* Practical experience in contract drafting, review, and negotiation.

* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools is an advantage
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and the ability to produce clear, well\-structured written work.
* Sound judgement in balancing legal and contractual risk against commercial objectives and project realities.
* Effective stakeholder management; collaborative team player able to work across multiple offices, time zones, and cultures.

 **Eaton’s Global Data Center Segmen** 
 t.
   

  

 Operating within the
 **Post Order Center of Excellence (CoE)** 
 , this role ensures that quality is designed into execution—not inspected in after the fact—by establishing global standards, assurance mechanisms, testing rigor, and process discipline that scale across regions, customers, and service offers. The position plays a critical role in enabling consistent, reliable, and repeatable customer outcomes while supporting Eaton’s growth with hyperscale and colocation data center customers worldwide. This role is based in Dubai, serving as a global coordination hub, and works across regions, time zones, and functions to drive a “one Eaton” quality mindset for post‑order delivery.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Global Quality Strategy \& Governance**
* Define and own the global post\-order quality strategy for the Global Data Center Segment, aligned with segment priorities, customer expectations, and Eaton enterprise standards.

**Quality Assurance \& Testing**
* Lead global assurance and testing methodologies to validate that post\-order deliverables, services, and execution outcomes meet defined quality, safety, and reliability standards.

**Process Quality \& Standardization**
* Own global process quality for post\-order execution, ensuring that standardized processes are clearly defined, documented, deployed, and adhered to.

**Overview**
 A position for FP\&A Manager has arisen to assist the Middle East Head of Financial Planning and Analysis and Finance Director, in delivering high quality and effective financial reporting, forecasting / budgeting, and project support function for MEA.  Your role
   

  

* The preparation of robust and complete quarterly forecasts and annual budget to the standards and timescales set by Group Finance functions.
* The preparation of month end accounts and completion of deliverables in an accurate manner and to a strict timetable.
* Act as finance business partner to regional central functions.
* Support the Head of FP\&A and Finance Director with ad\-hoc initiatives and analyses.
* Assist in driving business operational improvement projects and in setting up a strong control environment.
* Promote good financial practices throughout the business.
* Ensure compliance to business Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and use of best accounting practices.
* Develop strong working relationships with team members and other key stakeholders.
* Manage junior team members, ensuring their career development and coaching.
* Seek opportunities to learn new skills and aspire to develop within the team.


**About You**
**Technical Competencies**
****Essential****
* Fully Qualified ACCA/CIMA/ACA/CPA or other recognised Accounting qualification.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience within a business support Finance role .
* Highly organised and with the ability to prioritise tasks and delegate effectively.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint (knowledge of Data Modelling, PowerPivot and PowerBI tools is an advantage). Working knowledge of other Microsoft Office tools.
* Attention to detail with a high standard of (numerical) presentation skills.
* Produce insightful analysis and clearly communicate findings.
* Good understanding of a project lifecycle and the different measures of financial performance.
* Proven ability to develop strong working relationships and communicate effectively at all levels.
* Strong financial reporting skills with an understanding of IFRS.
* Highly analytical, able to manipulate and interpret complex data from multiple sources.
* Excellent communication in English (both written and oral).
* Experience of interacting with multiple businesses and finance functions.
* Experience of working within a multi\-cultural environment.
* Proven ability to develop strong working relationships and communicate effectively at all levels.


**Desirable**
* Prior experience working within an Engineering Consultancy business.
* Has prepared project related financial reports and reconciliations relating to, project expenses, billing, debt, provisions, and utilization.
* Exposure to preparing statutory returns and financial statements.
* Working knowledge of Oracle EBS, ePBCS, FCCS, Smart View and other IT systems and databases.


**Behavioural Competencies**
****Essential****
* Initiative – able to work independently with minimum supervision, make suggestions on best practice and improving current processes and procedures.
* Problem Solving – can think of creative solutions to problems.
* Analytical – able to analyse large volumes of date and clearly communicate findings.
* Strong interpersonal skills – able to develop productive internal working relationships with colleagues at all levels.
* Teamwork – willingly with others towards the same goals and objectives.
* Communication skills – clear, concise and relevant in both the verbal and written form.
* Work under Pressure – able to work under pressure when required to meet deadlines.
* Time Management – able to prioritise, plan ahead and achieve objectives within strict deadlines.
* Influencing – confident liaising with and influencing at all levels within the organization.

 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.

* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.

 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
