data.jd_text:
The Head of Construction/Construction Director oversees the full execution of the high\-rise development projects in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, from pre\-construction through to handover, acting as the key link between the project site, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders. In addition to technical and construction oversight, the role assumes broad project management responsibilities to ensure timely delivery, budget control, quality assurance, and alignment with MERED’s ultra\-luxury standards.
   





  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Act as the Client’s Point of contact on\-site, representing the company in all day\-to\-day project operations, stakeholder communications, technical decisions, and program management—ensuring seamless execution of the company’s development vision.
* Take responsibility for the execution and monitoring of the project master schedule, overseeing critical path activities and proactively resolving bottlenecks across all trades and work fronts.
* Lead all site\-level decision\-making, interfacing daily with the Consultant and Contractor, while aligning with the strategic objectives of the Executive Management team.
* Coordinate and chair all weekly progress meetings, technical coordination meetings, and task force sessions with internal and external parties; follow preparation of comprehensive MOMs, trackers, and follow\-ups to ensure accountability and implementation.
* Ensure that all procurement, long lead items, shop drawings, and authority approvals are aligned with the schedule and proactively track their timelines with the planning department to avoid execution delays.
* Review and assess contractor’s programs, lookahead plans, recovery schedules, and mitigation plans; reject or revise plans that do not meet MERED's standards or fail to support critical milestones.
* Monitor and supervise site works for full scope disciplines including:
+ Soil Investigation.
+ Enabling Works.
+ Structural: Sequencing, rebar installation, slab formwork, PT works, cast\-in items.
+ Architectural: Blockworks, waterproofing, screeding, ceiling frameworks, partitions, stone and tile installations.
+ Façade: System panels, brackets, brackets coordination with MEP penetrations and PT zones, balcony closures.
+ ID: Joinery, veneer mockups, lighting details, finishing tolerances, and detail verifications.
+ MEP: Shaft coordination, riser alignment, containment readiness, T\&C planning and authority inspections.

* Take charge of all government authority coordination (DDA, DEWA, Civil Defense, DM, RTA), ensuring that submissions, site inspections, approvals, and NOCs are prepared and executed on time.
* Maintain direct oversight of design coordination activities, ensuring all site conditions, RFI responses, and consultant instructions are technically reviewed, confirmed, and closed in collaboration with design managers and consultants.
* Represent the Developer in all commercial and contractual coordination together with commercial team by:
+ Evaluating technical claims, cost implications, and time extension requests.
+ Providing technical input to Contracts/Legal for variation orders, claims rebuttals, and scope clarifications.
+ Assessing additional work justifications and holding the Contractor accountable for scope performance.

* Take full leadership of QA/QC implementation:
+ Approve method statements and ITPs.
+ Review NCRs and ensure rectification with zero recurrence.
+ Verify material submittals, shop drawing accuracy, and as\-built records.

* Manage construction digital tools and systems, ensuring workflows, WIRs, MIRs, and document reviews are completed accurately, with continuous system training and performance follow\-up.
* Support planning department for internal weekly reporting to Executive Management:
+ Progress dashboards, milestone tracking, risk registers, productivity comparisons, and KPI compliance reviews.

* Oversee cost control interfaces with the commercial team by tracking site quantities, abortive works, unexecuted scope, and opportunities for value engineering or savings through optimization.
* Support the tendering process by preparing and coordinating technical evaluations, organizing site visits for bidders, reviewing PTC’s, technical submissions and providing input on contractor selection in coordination with the Commercial and Design teams.
* Support the Marketing team by preparing monthly construction progress updates, facilitating site readiness for content creation activities (photoshoots, videography, walkthroughs), and coordinating materials that reflect the company’s culture, particularly in health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Drive logistics and construction phasing strategies including crane operations, platform reconfigurations, hoist planning, material laydown, storage areas, and emergency access.
* Coordinate with the Contractor and Engineer to uphold a high standard of HSE culture across the project by leading weekly HSE\-focused site walks, enforcing compliance with UAE regulations and MERED’s internal safety policies, and ensuring that all activities reflect a clean, safe, and well\-managed construction environment.
* Spearhead initiatives to elevate site culture:
+ Ensure strict housekeeping compliance.
+ Maintain site readiness for walkthroughs.

* Facilitate pre\-handover activities including testing and commissioning, authority handover, DLP coordination, and unit inspections aligned with project branding and customer satisfaction goals.


 Requirements
   

  


**Required Qualifications**



* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or architecture.
* 15–20 years of experience in high\-rise construction, including luxury residential towers (experience with offices and hotels is a plus).
* Relevant experience in high\-rise construction projects in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
* Verifiable experience working for Tier 1 contractors or developers.
* Understanding of FIDIC contracts and construction contract administration.
* Knowledge of construction planning and phasing.
* Appreciation for customer care and commitment to handing over projects with a customer\-centric approach.
* Understanding of RERA inspections and approvals for Dubai projects, and relevant authority regulations for Abu Dhabi projects.
* Strong technical knowledge in structural, MEP, façade, ID, and authority regulations.
* Proficient in project management tools (Primavera, MS Project), AutoCAD, and document control systems.








**Preferred Qualifications**



* Professional certification if applicable, PMP certification or equivalent project management training.
* Experience with Dubai development regulations and authorities (DDA, DEWA, RTA, etc.).
* Exposure to design management or contractor\-side execution is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of sustainability certifications (LEED) in construction execution, if applicable.
* Industry\-recognized professional whose expertise and reputation are valued by contractors.



  





**Skills and Competencies**



* Strong leadership and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent coordination and conflict resolution skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail and organizational discipline.
* Proactive problem\-solver with a results\-oriented mindset.
* Comfortable managing complex teams and high\-pressure timelines.
* Fluent in English; knowledge of Russian or Arabic is an asset.



 ·
   

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

* Competitive salary package.
* Annual flight ticket allowance.
* Performance discretionary bonus.
* Comprehensive health insurance.
* Employment visa.

Your mission is simple: build and run a tight operating system that stabilises businesses quickly, drives revenue and EBITDA improvement, makes portfolio businesses exit\-ready, and ensures the engine behind both Portfolio and Agency runs with discipline, speed, and accountability.



  





 This is a highly commercial and turnaround\-focused role. You will take ownership of portfolio business performance, agency operations oversight, transition and handover discipline, EBITDA improvement, and Build Your Own project coordination, with the clear goal of turning around the businesses we manage and making them commercially stronger, more stable, and less founder\-dependent. You will work closely with our COO, CEO and leadership team to ensure operations directly support commercial outcomes, retention, and exit readiness. We are looking for a Head of Agency \| Marketing Director \| Customer Success with a strong operator background in e\-commerce, portfolio management, or multi\-brand business operations. Someone who understands revenue, margin, and EBITDA, how to identify where a business is leaking, how to move fast, and how to use AI tools and workflows to run a lean and highly effective operating department. Are you the next Head of Agency ready to scale Ecomma to the next level?
 



  





 What you will do
 



  




* **Own Portfolio Business Performance** 
 : Take full ownership of the weekly operating rhythm across all active portfolio businesses. Track revenue, gross margin, and EBITDA by business, identify underperforming brands early, and drive recovery plans that push businesses toward stronger commercial performance and exit readiness.
* **Drive Agency Operations Oversight** 
 : Oversee the operating side of agency\-managed businesses after handover. Ensure clear alignment between what has been promised and what is realistically deliverable, with tight coordination between CSM, performance, ops, and technical support. Improve account stability, issue resolution speed, and internal accountability to support retention.
* **Own Transition and Handover Discipline:** 
 Own and enforce seller\-to\-portfolio and portfolio\-to\-agency handover standards. Ensure all required inputs, documents, and business context are transferred properly, flag incomplete handovers early, and reduce loss of momentum during change of ownership and internal transition.
* **Drive EBITDA and Self\-Sustainability:** 
 Push portfolio businesses toward stronger EBITDA performance. Improve visibility into what is driving profitability or dragging it down, support working capital awareness and operational cost discipline, and help the division move toward being financially healthier and less dependent on founder intervention.
* **Oversee Build Your Own Projects:** 
 Lead the operational coordination of active BYO projects once live. Ensure structured follow\-through across launch, setup, and performance phases, and coordinate with relevant teams to keep projects moving and commercially on track.
* **Solve Cross\-Functional Operating Issues:** 
 Work with internal teams to resolve supplier, logistics, customer service, marketing, and website issues affecting portfolio performance. Be the person who unblocks things quickly so senior leadership does not need to jump in constantly.
* **Make Portfolio Businesses Exit\-Ready:** 
 Drive brands toward stronger commercial performance, operational stability, and sellability so portfolio numbers become visible, reliable, and improving.
* **Build a High\-Performance Operating Team:** 
 Set a clear weekly cadence for priorities, blockers, follow\-ups, and accountability. Ensure team members know what they own and by when, push for strong follow\-through rather than just updates, and escalate issues early rather than allowing drift.
* **Implement AI\-First Workflows:** 
 Bring an AI\-first mindset to the operating department by using AI tools, automations, and systems to improve speed, output, reporting, and team efficiency across portfolio and agency.
* **Track Performance Relentlessly:** 
 Set clear KPIs and reporting structures across portfolio and agency, including portfolio revenue growth, EBITDA, number of exit\-ready businesses, time to stabilise post\-handover, red/at\-risk brand count, recovery rate on underperforming brands, handover completion quality, and operational SLA follow\-through. You understand that operations exist to generate measurable business outcomes, not activity reports.
* **Improve Stability and Accountability:** 
 Continuously refine operating rhythm, escalation paths, and cross\-functional discipline so agency ops become less reactive and more structured, and businesses stop drifting after handover.
* **Create a Scalable Operating Engine:** 
 Build an operating function that is structured, repeatable, lean, and able to scale alongside the company as we continue to grow.



  





 We operate using Google Workspace, Slack, and Notion. Thus, familiarity and hands\-on experience with these platforms are important for this role. The candidate should be fluent in English, with excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. A strong commercial instinct, analytical thinking, fast execution, and high ownership are essential. Tools in use may include portfolio performance trackers, P\&L and EBITDA reporting dashboards, handover and documentation systems, project and task management platforms, client/account management tools, and AI platforms that improve output, speed, and operating efficiency.
 



  





 What you bring to the table:
 


* 5\+ years of experience in e\-commerce operations, portfolio management, multi\-brand business operations, or agency operations leadership, ideally in a high\-growth, roll\-up, or aggregator environment.
* Proven experience stabilising, turning around, and driving commercial improvement across multiple businesses at the same time.
* A strong background in operations and commercial performance, with clear evidence that you know how to move businesses from underperforming to exit\-ready.
* Experience leading and coordinating cross\-functional teams, including CSM, performance, ops, finance, and client/account contributors.
* A highly commercial mindset. You understand revenue, gross margin, and EBITDA, not just task execution, and you know how operations should directly support commercial outcomes.
* Experience working in e\-commerce operations, roll\-up/aggregator/multi\-brand portfolios, agency operations, or GM/multi\-store environments is a strong plus.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence with P\&L, reporting, attribution, and decision\-making based on data.
* An AI\-first mindset. You actively use AI tools, workflows, and automations to improve operating output, team efficiency, and speed of execution.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple businesses, handovers, and priorities at the same time.
* Strong follow\-through, escalation, and cross\-functional coordination skills. Able to work with performance, ops, finance, and client/account teams without getting lost in the noise.
* A hands\-on mentality. You are strategic, but you are also willing to dig into the detail, fix issues directly, and drive accountability when needed.
* Calm under pressure, but not soft on accountability. High standards, strong ownership, and the ability to build a culture of urgency and operational clarity.
* Fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* High ethical standards and a commitment to conducting business with integrity.



  





 The position will be filled immediately for the right candidate.
 



  





 Working at Ecomma is more than just a job. If you believe in seizing the present to enhance your future, you're in the right place. Combining hard work with the right atmosphere is our golden formula. We don't operate with a 9\-6 mindset, allowing you to manage your own working hours. We've found this approach yields the best results. Ecomma: a private equity firm you can count on.
 



  





 Please note: Proficiency in English is required.
 



  





 Does this opportunity excite you? Are you eager to dive in and unleash your creative finance mind? If you want to be a part of the Ecomma team, send your motivation letter and CV addressed to the respective job title application.
 



  





*If this role isn't a fit for you but you know someone it might suit, please share it with them \- we'd greatly appreciate it!*

data.jd_text:
The Construction Director is the senior leader responsible for overseeing the delivery performance of the EPC contractor across the full project life cycle. Reporting directly to the CEO, this role leads project planning, design coordination, procurement, construction, and commissioning.
   

  

 The successful candidate will help ensure the project is delivered on time, within budget, to the required quality standards, and in line with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements. This is a key leadership role for someone with strong experience in large and complex civil infrastructure projects.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Project Planning And Delivery**
* Develop, implement, and oversee the overall project plan, including schedules, budgets, resource planning, and quality control procedures.
* Make sure project delivery remains aligned with the company's strategic objectives.


**Construction Execution And Site Leadership**
* Lead and monitor all construction activities, including civil works, tunnelling, pipe\-laying, treatment plant construction, and related infrastructure.
* Support efficient site progress, compliance with specifications, and timely resolution of on\-site issues.


**Contract, Procurement, And Contractor Management**
* Oversee the selection, negotiation, and management of major EPC contractors, subcontractors, and key suppliers.
* Ensure contractors and suppliers meet their contractual obligations and perform effectively.


**Risk, Quality, And Compliance**
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks across technical, operational, financial, safety, and environmental areas.
* Implement strong quality assurance and quality control practices to support delivery of a high\-quality and sustainable asset.


**Stakeholder Management And Reporting**
* Act as the main point of contact for technical and construction\-related matters with the CEO, Board, lenders' technical advisors, regulatory authorities, and other key stakeholders.
* Provide clear, accurate, and regular progress updates to leadership and stakeholders.


 Academic Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related field from a reputable university.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Project Management, or Business Administration (MBA) is highly preferred.
* Professional Engineer (PE) licence or an equivalent professional accreditation in civil engineering or construction.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or an equivalent certification (for example PgMP or MSP) is highly desirable.
* Ongoing professional development in advanced construction techniques, tunnelling methods, or water/wastewater infrastructure is an advantage.


**Experience Requirements**
* Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience in civil infrastructure construction.
* At least 10 years in a senior project management or Construction Director role on mega\-projects valued above USD 2 billion.
* Proven success in leading the full life cycle delivery of at least one large\-scale tunnelling project and/or sewage or wastewater treatment plant project, from concept through commissioning.
* Extensive experience managing large, multidisciplinary construction teams, including direct labour, contractors, and consultants, in fast\-paced and high\-pressure environments.
* Strong understanding of project delivery methods such as EPC and Design\-Build, including management of complex interfaces between work packages.
* Demonstrated experience developing and managing project budgets above USD 1 billion, schedules, risk registers, and cost control and progress reporting systems.


 Key Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate teams, resolve conflicts, and negotiate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
* Strong technical knowledge in tunnelling (including TBM operations and ground improvement), large\-diameter pipe\-laying, and advanced wastewater treatment processes.
* Ability to make important decisions under pressure, solve complex technical and logistical issues, and adapt to changing project conditions.
* High level of resilience and adaptability, with the ability to manage uncertainty and respond effectively during critical situations.
* Good knowledge of international construction standards, HSE regulations, and quality management systems such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 / OHSAS 18001\.
* Advanced proficiency in project management software such as Primavera P6, MS Project, BIM tools, and other relevant construction management technologies.

 WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.  For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

data.jd_text:
**JOB TITLE**
**Director International Regulatory Policy and Intelligence (International Regulatory Affairs) – MEA \& Eurasia**
**About Astrazeneca**
 AstraZeneca is a global, science\-led, patient\-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role is a strategic role with responsibility as international regulatory policy and intelligence director focusing on the MEA and Eurasia Region (EAEU, Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia) and working closely with Senior Area Regulatory Director (SARD)\- MEA, SARD Eurasia, International Policy \& Intelligence Senior Director, Marketing Companies within the region, and regional and global functions. This role will be part of International Regulatory Policy and Intelligence Team.
   

  

 The International Director for MEA and Eurasia Regulatory Policy and Intelligence is responsible for driving the development of impactful regulatory policy and advocacy with primary focus in the MEA and Eurasia regions and key international topics in cooperation with global, regional, local and functional experts. Also, will lead regulatory intelligence and legislation surveillance across the region, translating legislative developments and regulatory trends into strategic insights that enable to anticipate challenges, seize opportunities, and ensure our medicines reach patients across the region.
   

  

 The Director provides a broad strategic view for regulatory policy issues based on in\-depth knowledge of the internal and external regulatory environment in MEA and Eurasia and across key international topics .The Director will contribute to and co\-develop policy positions including stakeholder interactions and help to implement these policy positions regionally, leading to more impactful external engagements for AZ’s regulatory science priority topics, disease areas of interest, new therapeutic modalities, CMC \& quality, and cross\-area topics.
   

  

 The Director will be a major participant in articulating AZ’s consolidated view on key international and MEA and Eurasia Region regulatory guidance and regulations. This includes maintaining and developing key health authority relationships and being able to influence proposed rules and regulations that specifically impact AZ and ultimately the pharmaceutical industry. The incumbent can also lead implementation of changes to international strategy and processes due to significant regulatory environment changes (new legislation/guidance etc.) and can lead AZ’s response to key regulatory policy topics within MEA and Eurasia, and at Global and International Level. The director will assess the impact of new legislative/environmental changes on product strategy and communicate relevant information to international Regulatory Affairs (inRA) Strategy groups for onward communication to Global Project Teams
   

  

 The Director will have a major role interacting with other parts of the AZ organization that are influencing policy and legislation at local, regional, and global levels and developing advocacy plans for their areas of responsibility whilst capturing key KPIs and metrics.
   

  

 The Director attends relevant external meetings or conferences of value to the business, and contributes to the overall strategy, direction and efficient operation of the function. There will be an opportunity for the incumber to engage with Governments, trade associations, and other stakeholders on international policy issues and represent AZ in the relevant platforms externally.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead or manage regulatory policy priority topics as coordinated by the Global Regulatory Policy Team /International Policy and Intelligence lead
* Provide key regulatory procedural/ environmental advice on assigned topics to key customers/stakeholders within international and Global, including the Regulatory TAs, Commercial, MC regulatory, R\&D, Operations and CMO functions.
* Support preparation of regulatory policy documents, including position statements, reports, draft papers and presentation materials.
* Support with the oversight and management of international policy and intelligence scorecard KPIs, and its metrics for performance internally and externally
* Support the development for the International Regulatory Policy Training Capability Framework within MEA and Eurasia
* Establish the international CMC\-RA Policy Framework in collaboration with international CMC RA
* Represents AZ International Regulatory Affairs on selected external International Trade Association committees, with focus on MEA and Eurasia, to ensure AZ International Regulatory views on key issues are represented
* Attend relevant external meetings/conferences, with focus in MEA and Eurasia, to obtain relevant intelligence of value to the business and communicate effectively.
* May represent AZ in external benchmarking on advocacy business practices.
* Has personal responsibility for creating a culture of courageous leadership, creativity and collaboration
* Contribute to the strategy, direction and efficient operation of the immediate team and function.


**Essential For The Role**
* 10\+ years in global regulatory affairs, including international regions (Asia, Latin America and Middle East \& Africa)
* Understands the role of external policy and advocacy and connections to business goals in the International Regions.
* Demonstrated expertise in Regulatory policy related matters, through Health Authority or Industry experience, and more specifically in two or more International Regions such as Asia, Eurasia, Latin America and Middle East \& Africa.
* Working knowledge of AZ focused disease areas, new therapeutic modalities, CMC \& quality, and cross\-area topics.
* Thorough understanding and application of the Drug Development and associated regulatory processes globally and internationally. Prior experience with phase 3 design including end of phase 2 health authority interactions is desired. Contribution to a regulatory approval including leading response team and labelling negotiations would be a plus.
* Working experience in developing and executing new product strategies for global and international regions across different therapeutic areas
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset—comfortable with ambiguity and adept at building from the ground up
* Demonstrated proficiencies in critical thinking, critical influencing, innovation, initiative, leadership and excellent oral and written communication skills.
* The ability to think strategically and critically and evaluate risks to regulatory activities.
* Collaborative and able to build consensus with peers and leadership (ability to influence upwards)
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Experience in knowledge management and digital information management


**Desirable for the role**
* Experience working in Health Authority
* Problem solving skills
* Focus on delivery and results
* Experience in new modalities ie antibody conjugates, cell and gene therapy, radiotherapeutics
* Experience of participating in key industry groups and policy for especially within MEA and Eurasia
* Excellent strategic influencing and negotiation
* Experienced Regulatory Professional with degree in scientific discipline, typically pharmacy and biological science.
* Experience or aptitude in using AI/Gen AI within regulatory space.


**Why AstraZeneca?**
 At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
   

  

**So, what’s next?**
* Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
* Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a Resident Architect to join our DSA team in Dubai.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview**




  





 To lead the on\-site architectural supervision and consultant services for major construction projects. This includes the administration of post\-contract responsibilities as defined by the appointment, managing and coordinating multidisciplinary site teams where applicable, ensuring alignment with the approved design intent, and monitoring compliance with the project’s contract, codes, and specifications. When appointed in a Design Guardian capacity, the role is limited to safeguarding the design intent through review, coordination, and advisory input only, and does not include construction supervision, inspection, certification, contract administration, or Defects Liability Period services unless expressly agreed and appointed under a separate scope. The role serves as a primary interface between the client, contractors, design teams, and other stakeholders. The exact scope of services may differ on a project\-by\-project basis and will be further defined as part of the project\-specific deliverables..
 



  





**2\.Job Accountabilities Linked To Objectives**




  





 The Resident Architect is responsible for leading the on\-site project team and driving the successful delivery of the project. As the most senior project representative for DSA on site, this role carries the critical responsibility of safeguarding the company’s interests, contractual, legal, and commercial responsibilities throughout the construction phase and ensuring the project aligns with DSA’s standards and obligations.
 



  





 The Resident Architect may be assigned responsibilities across one or multiple projects, as well as strategic or special initiatives aligned with the company's broader objectives. These special assignments may extend beyond project\-specific duties and can include tasks such as conducting quality audits, developing procedures, manuals and supporting internal process improvements \& development.
 



  





 In all cases, the Resident Architect is expected to work closely, not only with their direct team/ the Client but also with their immediate supervisor and line manager to clearly define the scope of responsibilities, deliverables, and resource requirements specific to each assignment. The final scope of duties and level of authority will be established in consultation with and subject to approval by the Site Operations Director, Project Director or relevant senior leadership.
 



  





**A. Design Site Leadership** 




 • Lead the site\-based lead consultancy team (where present) to ensure high standards of quality, compliance, coordination, and delivery across all stakeholders, proactively addressing deficiencies as they arise.
 



 • Oversee and assist with design deliverables, pre\-engineering, shop drawings, RFIs, submittals, inspections, and construction queries to support timely resolution and adherence to project requirements.
 



 • Review and approve works, including but not limited to mock\-ups, sample rooms, materials, and finishes, ensuring alignment with the approved design / designer, specifications, and project requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective design coordination across all disciplines and contribute to the resolution of design and construction\-related conflicts.
 



 • Conduct regular architectural and design\-focused site walks to monitor the implementation of the approved design intent, including look, feel, materiality, and spatial quality.
 



 • Identify, document, and report design, aesthetic, and quality\-related risks or non\-compliances to the LDC / Client through structured observations and reporting.
 



 • Prepare and issue monthly architectural / design guardianship reports summarising site observations, key risks, and matters requiring attention.
 



 • Review and provide comments on material samples, mock\-ups, mood boards, finishes, look \& feel assessments, and sample rooms to support alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Provide architectural and interior design clarifications, including aesthetic and design intent matters, where requested by the Client.
 



 • Participate in value engineering and design development discussions, providing input on architectural quality, aesthetic impact, and alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Coordinate closely with PMCM, the Contractor, and the wider consultant team during site reviews, technical meetings, and design discussions to maintain alignment between design intent, construction execution, and client expectations.
 



 • Monitor that the executed works reflect the approved design, client expectations, and applicable codes and regulations throughout the construction process.
 



 • Ensure RFIs, approvals, instructions, and IFC changes are managed through the established project communication and authority channels and are properly coordinated across all parties.
 



 • Produce and issue timely internal and external dashboards capturing progress, quality, design alignment, and emerging risks.
 



  





**B. Site Supervision Team Management** 




 • Direct and manage the day\-to\-day performance of DSA's site supervision team (architects, engineers, inspectors, sub\-consultants and the like).
 



 • Ensure all team members are properly briefed on their roles and responsibilities.
 



 • Implement structured delegation and reporting mechanisms.
 



 • Conduct periodic audits, QA/QC / technical reviews, and performance assessments.
 



 • Maintain a collaborative, professional, and high\-performing supervision environment on site.
 



 • Ensure employees / team members conduct are upheld to the highest standards
 



 • Monitor and update in coordination with the Client and Site Operations Director the project, staff deployment, associated schedule and ensure timely delivery of the same at the agreed frequency
 



  





**C. Project \& Contract Administration** 




 • Oversee compliance with the project’s construction contract (FIDIC or equivalent).
 



 • Issue formal communications, manage variations, evaluate contractor claims, and contribute to extension of time assessments.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation, records \& communication protocols are established, used and maintained for all supervision activities.
 



 • Coordinate with the Employer’s Representative and Client\-appointed Consultants.
 



 • Act as Engineer’s Representative / Employer’s Representative if appointed, ensuring responsibilities are discharged in line with the delegated authority.
 



 • Assist in stake holder and lead in team dispute resolution
 



  





**D. Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Interface** 




 • Act as the senior site representative of the lead consultant.
 



 • Establish and manage coordination mechanisms among the consultant team, contractor, suppliers, and client representatives.
 



 • Participate in progress meetings, site coordination meetings, and technical reviews.
 



 • Monitor and steer project progress and associated scheduling and produce relevant reports
 



 • Provide strategic input and advice to the client to ensure project objectives are met.
 



  





**E. Quality \& Compliance Oversight** 




 • Enforce quality control standards and escalate issues that risk the design quality or compliance of the project / deliverables
 



 • Monitor health, safety, and environmental practices on site.
 



 • Participate in final inspections, testing, and commissioning phases.
 



 • Ensure defect lists, non\-conformance reports and site observations are compiled and rectified in line with contract obligations.
 



 • Ensure pre\-engineering deliverables are in line with contract agreement and implement measures to maintain and or rectify resulting shortfalls
 



 • Monitor and advise on change control process
 



  





**F. Leadership \& Mentorship** 




 • Serve as mentor and technical advisor to staff, engineers and sub\-consultants.
 



 • Lead internal training and onboarding of new site staff.
 



 • Foster a knowledge\-sharing culture that emphasizes continuous improvement and professional development to the benefit of the project and company.
 



  





**G. Commercial \& Invoicing Responsibilities** 




 • Coordinate with the head office/accounts team to prepare and validate monthly consultancy service invoices in line with contract terms.
 



 • Review and confirm site\-based and related staff, timesheets for inclusion in monthly billing.
 



 • Collect, verify, and consolidate sub\-consultant timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and scope alignment.
 



 • Track sub\-consultant invoices and ensure timely submission to accounts for processing.
 



 • Maintain a project\-specific log of all invoicing activities, including issue dates, payment terms, and receipt confirmations amongst others.
 



 • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with clients and relevant stakeholders to ensure prompt payment.
 



 • Flag and escalate delays in payment or disputed invoices to the Project Director and commercial team.
 



 • Liaise with sub\-consultants regarding their payment status and provide updates on payment cycles and client approvals.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal financial procedures and contractual invoicing requirements.
 



 • Support monthly project \& financial reporting with updates on invoice status, forecasted income, and payment risks.
 



 • Assist in reconciling client payment records with internal accounts to resolve discrepancies, if any.
 



 • Track any approved variations or scope changes and coordinate with the commercial team to ensure these are invoiced accordingly.
 



  





**3\. Qualification / Experience / Requirements**




  





 • Qualified Architect (BArch / MArch) with minimum 15 years’ experience; at least 10 years on\-site in the Middle East.
 



 • Proven experience as a Resident Architect on large\-scale or complex projects.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of FIDIC contract administration and construction management practices.
 



 • Experience managing multidisciplinary supervision teams in fast\-track environments.
 



 • Familiar with UAE/ Regional Authority codes, regulations, and approval procedures.
 



 • PMP, MCIOB, or similar certifications are advantageous.
 



 • Strong documentation, reporting, technical and problem\-solving capabilities.
 



  





 Interested candidates can share their resume directly on recruit.dxb@dsa\-arch.com mentioning "Resident Architect" as a subject.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration. From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time. Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues. The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.



  









**Qualifications** 




  





  




* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management.
* Demonstrated management and project management skills.



  









**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy.
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection.
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority.
* Excellent professional image/presentation.
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style.
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills.
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio.
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.



  





  





 Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered. Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.
 



  





  





 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organization of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex port and marine infrastructure projects in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of large\-scale maritime projects while managing cross\-functional teams, stakeholders, and resources. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, analytical thinking, and a comprehensive understanding of ports and marine operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
   

  




* Direct end\-to\-end project delivery for ports and marine infrastructure initiatives, ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, and budget parameters
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and resource allocation strategies using industry\-standard project management tools

* Manage stakeholder communications and expectations across multiple organizational levels and external partners
* Oversee contract negotiations, vendor management, and procurement activities in compliance with organizational policies
* Lead and mentor project teams, fostering collaboration and accountability to achieve project objectives
* Monitor project performance metrics and prepare comprehensive status reports for senior leadership
* Ensure compliance with maritime regulations, safety standards, and local regulatory requirements specific to UAE operations
* Coordinate with engineering, operations, and technical teams to resolve issues and optimize project outcomes
* Conduct post\-project reviews and implement lessons learned to enhance future project delivery


**Qualifications**

 \*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*
   

  




* Minimum 8\+ years of project management experience, with at least 5 years in ports, marine, or maritime infrastructure projects

* Strong knowledge of maritime industry operations, port facilities, and marine engineering principles

* Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and manage complex stakeholder relationships



 \*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*
   

  




* Experience managing projects in the Middle East region
* Familiarity with marine terminal operations and cargo handling systems
* Experience with design\-build or engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models
* Advanced certifications in risk management or specialized maritime project management


**Additional Information**

 Degree in Civil engineering

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The Head of Primary is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight, management, and continuous improvement of the primary school. This role ensures the delivery of high\-quality, inclusive education, promotes whole\-child development, and contributes to school\-wide strategic planning.
   

  

 The postholder will lead academic and pastoral priorities, oversee curriculum and assessment, drive professional development, and monitor teaching and learning outcomes. The role is aligned with UK Teachers’ Standards, KHDA Framework, and the School Improvement Plan (SIP), ensuring excellence across teaching, leadership, inclusion, and student achievement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership and Management
   

  

* Lead the primary phase in line with school\-wide SIP objectives and SEF priorities, contributing to whole\-school strategy.
* Develop, implement, and evaluate phase\-wide action plans, ensuring alignment with KHDA SEF criteria and school improvement goals.
* Monitor student progress, teaching quality, and departmental performance, using data to inform targeted interventions and continuous improvement.
* Lead, mentor, and appraise all primary staff, fostering professional growth, collaboration, and high morale.
* Manage resources, budgets, and facilities to optimise learning opportunities across the phase.


 Teaching and Learning Oversight
   

  

* Ensure high\-quality, engaging, and inclusive teaching across the primary phase.
* Promote cross\-curricular literacy, numeracy, STEM, and creative skills, embedding UAE heritage and values.
* Develop innovative, evidence\-based teaching approaches and ensure effective differentiation for all learners, including ELL students and Students of Determination.
* Lead curriculum planning and development in line with UK curriculum expectations, MoE requirements, and international best practice.


 Assessment, Monitoring, and Reporting
   

  

* Analyse data to monitor progress, attainment, and trends across the primary phase.
* Ensure robust assessment, tracking, and reporting systems are in place and inform SEF evaluations.
* Provide strategic recommendations to SLT to enhance student achievement and wellbeing.


 Pastoral and Safeguarding Leadership
   

  

* Promote a safe, nurturing, and inclusive learning environment.
* Ensure proactive safeguarding, pastoral care, and support for Students of Determination.
* Champion student wellbeing, resilience, and personal development.


 Collaboration and Community Engagement
   

  

* Act as a key representative of the primary phase within SLT and the wider school community.
* Build strong partnerships with parents, the community, and external agencies to enhance student learning and wellbeing.
* Lead primary phase participation in school\-wide initiatives, enrichment, and extracurricular programs.


**Essential**
 Skills, Qualifications, and Experience
   

  

* Qualified teacher with extensive primary leadership experience
* Minimum 5–7 years teaching experience with at least 3 years in leadership or middle/senior management
* Deep understanding of curriculum design, assessment, differentiation, and inclusion
* Proven experience in strategic planning, staff mentoring, and managing performance
* Strong knowledge of safeguarding, pastoral care, and wellbeing


**Desirable**
* Experience in UAE or international schools
* Familiarity with KHDA inspections, SEF, SIP, and MoE curriculum for primary


 Competencies and Attributes
   

  

* Strategic, visionary, and collaborative senior leader
* Empathetic, culturally aware, and approachable
* Innovative, proactive, and solution\-focused
* Strong organisational, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills
* Committed to excellence in teaching, learning, inclusion, and wellbeing
* Integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism


 Alignment to Standards
   

  

**UK Teachers’ Standards (Leadership Focus)**
* Set and maintain high expectations for students and staff
* Ensure effective teaching and learning strategies across the primary phase
* Manage behaviour, pastoral care, and professional responsibilities effectively
* Lead continuous professional development and mentoring


**KHDA SEF \& Education Inspection Framework**
* Student Achievement and Progress – strategic oversight and intervention planning
* Teaching for Effective Learning – ensure consistent, high\-quality pedagogy
* Personal Development, Behaviour, and Wellbeing – support confidence, independence, and resilience
* Provision for Students of Determination – inclusive practices and differentiated support
* Leadership, Collaboration, and Professional Responsibilities – contribute to SEF self\-evaluation, SIP targets, and whole\-school improvement


**School Improvement Plan (SIP) Alignment**
* Drive whole\-school priorities and measurable outcomes for the primary phase
* Lead initiatives to raise attainment, close gaps, and enhance teaching quality
* Ensure departmental and phase actions support school\-wide strategic goals


**UAE Ministry Of Education Alignment**
* Deliver lessons according to MoE curriculum standards for primary
* Embed UAE heritage, culture, and values within the curriculum
* Champion inclusion and development of Students of Determination


**ISP Principles**
**Begin with our children and students** 
 . Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding
   

  

 and Health \& Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.
   

  

**Treat everyone with care and respect** 
 . We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well\-being of self and others.
   

  

**Operate effectively.** 
 We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.
   

  

**Are financially responsible.** 
 We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.
   

  

**Learn continuously.** 
 Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.
   

  

**ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles**
 ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.
   

  

**ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high\-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio\-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

data.jd_text:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
   

  

**Job Function**
 Corporate Affairs
   

  

**Job Level**
 P4
   

  

**Supervisor**
 Senior Director, Head of Corporate Affairs, Gulf
   

  

**Location**
 Dubai, UAE, with regular travel to other Gulf markets as required
   

  

**Position Description**
 The Associate Director \- External Affairs \& Corporate Communications Lead, holds end\-to\-end accountability for the design and delivery of an integrated communications function spanning corporate reputation, internal communications, media relations, executive positioning, crisis management, and therapeutic area communications across the UAE, Kuwait, and Qatar.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role operating with a high degree of autonomy and strategic independence. The role serves as the primary communications advisor to the General Manager and the Head of Corporate Affairs, Gulf, making independent judgements on reputational risk, issues response, and communications strategy across a complex, multi\-market environment.
   

  

 A distinctive element of this role is serving as the communications lead for Lilly's Oncology and Neuroscience therapeutic areas in the Gulf, working closely with the respective business units, cross functional teams including medical affairs teams to develop disease awareness campaigns, support product communications, and position Lilly as a leader in these critical areas of medicine. The role also holds Gulf\-wide accountability for digital and media strategy and represents Lilly's communications function in cross\-functional leadership forums and global communications networks.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Communications Strategy and Function Leadership:**
* Hold full strategic and operational ownership of the Gulf communications function, setting in collaborations with the Therapeutic Communications Lead, a multi\-year direction and annual plans across all communications disciplines.
* Define the Gulf communications strategy, ensuring coherent integration across corporate reputation, internal communications, therapeutic area communications, media, digital, and executive positioning workstreams.
* Align Gulf strategy with Lilly's global communications framework, brand positioning, and enterprise messaging, while exercising independent judgement to adapt and prioritise for regional context.
* Establish annual communications plans with clear objectives, key messages, target audiences, channels, budget allocation, and measurable success metrics.
* Serve as counsel to the General Manager and Head of Corporate Affairs, providing proactive strategic advice on communications opportunities, emerging risks, and reputational considerations.
* Represent the Gulf communications function in relevant global communications leadership networks and cross\-regional forums.
* Hold accountability for the Gulf communications budget, including agency and vendor management, resource allocation, and financial reporting.
* Monitor communications trends, best practices, and emerging channels to ensure Lilly's approach remains effective and contemporary.
* Provide functional guidance and subject matter direction to the Senior Manager, Therapeutic Communications, ensuring alignment with the overall Gulf communications strategy and quality standards.


**External Communications And Media Relations**
* Develop and oversee the external communications strategy that enhances Lilly's visibility and reputation across the Gulf.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with journalists, editors, and media outlets across the region.
* Oversee development of press materials including press releases, media statements, Q\&As, and backgrounders.
* Coordinate media interviews and briefings for the General Manager, Head of Corporate Affairs, and other Lilly spokespeople.
* Direct media monitoring and provide regular analysis and reporting on Lilly's share of voice and reputation indicators.
* Oversee management of media enquiries and ensure timely, accurate, and on\-message responses.
* Direct social media and digital communications strategies to engage external stakeholders and amplify Lilly's presence across the Gulf.


**Internal Communications And Employee Engagement**
* Develop and own the internal communications strategy for the Gulf region, ensuring employees across all three markets are consistently informed, engaged, and connected to Lilly's purpose and priorities.
* Serve as the primary internal communications advisor to the General Manager and leadership team, supporting communication of business updates, commercial milestones, strategic priorities, and organisational changes.
* Develop a Gulf\-wide internal communications calendar aligned to the regional business cycle, global enterprise communications moments, and key employee engagement touchpoints.
* Create and oversee production of internal communications content across relevant channels including leadership messages, town hall materials, intranet content, newsletters, and all\-staff announcements.
* Lead change management communications for Gulf\-specific organisational or operational changes, ensuring employees receive timely, clear, and consistent messaging.
* Partner with Human Resources on employee engagement initiatives, recognition programmes, and culture\-building communications.
* Coordinate with the global internal communications function to cascade enterprise messages, ensuring global narratives are adapted for Gulf context, cultural nuance, and language where required.
* Establish metrics to track employee communications reach, engagement, and effectiveness, and use insights to continuously improve the internal communications approach.


**Oncology \& Neuroscience Therapeutic Area Communications**
* Serve as the communications lead for Lilly's Oncology and Neuroscience businesses in the Gulf region.
* Develop and oversee communications strategies that support product launches, lifecycle management, and market access objectives for both therapeutic areas.
* Direct development of disease awareness campaigns and educational content on cancers, neurological conditions, and psychiatric disorders addressed by Lilly's portfolio.
* Partner with Oncology and Neuroscience medical affairs teams on scientific communications, congress presence, and key opinion leader engagement.
* Lead efforts to address stigma and raise awareness around mental health and neurological conditions through thoughtful and sensitive communications.
* Oversee development of patient stories and testimonials that humanise the impact of Lilly's medicines in compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with global therapeutic area communications teams to align regional activities with enterprise campaigns and messaging.


**Executive Communications And Thought Leadership**
* Develop and manage executive communications programmes for the General Manager and leadership team.
* Oversee development of speeches, presentations, op\-eds, and thought leadership content for senior executives.
* Identify speaking opportunities at conferences, industry events, and media platforms to enhance executive visibility.
* Prepare executives for media interviews, panel discussions, and public appearances.


**Reputation Management And Issues Response**
* Hold primary accountability for monitoring, assessing, and managing reputational risks across the Gulf region, making real\-time judgement calls on issues response and escalation.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive issues management framework and crisis communications playbooks for the Gulf, ensuring readiness across a range of scenarios.
* Provide independent counsel to the General Manager and Head of Corporate Affairs on reputational matters, including recommended positions, messaging, and stakeholder management approaches.
* Coordinate with global communications, legal, and compliance on sensitive matters, ensuring appropriate escalation and alignment with enterprise\-level positions.


**Senior Leadership Visits And Events**
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in planning and executing communications for visits by global executives and senior leaders.
* Oversee development of communications materials, media opportunities, and internal announcements related to executive visits.
* Lead communications planning and execution for corporate events, product launches, and stakeholder gatherings.


**Reporting, Measurement, And Administration**
* Establish metrics and measurement frameworks to evaluate communications effectiveness and impact across all channels.
* Prepare regular reports on communications activities, media coverage, reputation indicators, and employee engagement for the Head of Corporate Affairs.
* Manage relationships with external agencies, consultants, and vendors supporting respective communications activities.
* Ensure all communications activities comply with Lilly's policies, industry codes, and regulatory requirements.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 12–15 years of progressive experience in corporate communications, public affairs, or a related field, with a demonstrable trajectory of increasing seniority and scope.
* Proven track record of operating as a senior communications strategist and advisor, with demonstrated ability to set and own a communications function agenda independently across multiple disciplines simultaneously.
* At least eight years focused on healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences communications, with deep familiarity with the regulatory and compliance environment governing pharmaceutical communications.
* Proven experience owning an integrated, multi\-workstream communications function spanning corporate reputation, internal communications, media, digital, and therapeutic area communications
* Experience in the Gulf region or broader Middle East, with strong understanding of the regional media landscape, cultural and stakeholder dynamics, and multi\-market operating environments.
* Demonstrated track record in crisis communications and issues management, including leading real\-time response and advising senior leadership independently and under pressure.
* Proven ability to develop and deliver executive communications and thought leadership programmes for General Manager and senior leadership audiences.
* Experience in therapeutic area communications, with Oncology and/or Neuroscience experience particularly valued.
* Strong media relations skills with established relationships with Gulf\-based journalists and media outlets.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders, including General Manager\-level leadership, with credibility, gravitas, and independence.
* Experience managing agency relationships, communications budgets, and vendor performance at a senior level.
* Familiarity with digital communications, social media strategies, and emerging platforms.
* Excellent writing, editing, and presentation skills in English; ability to communicate with precision and impact across diverse audiences.
* Arabic language proficiency required.
* Degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, or a related discipline; advanced degree desirable.

data.jd_text:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.
   

  

**A Regional Head of HR with a global leader in the fascinating world of Taste \& Wellbeing and Fragrance \& Beauty \- Your future position?**
 As an essential member of the Regional Management team for the high\-growth South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa (SAMEA) region, you will manage a team of 20 HR professionals via 5 direct reports across the SAMEA region. You will drive Givaudan’s global, functional, and regional HR agenda and partner with management teams to deliver business results aligned with Givaudan’s purpose and strategy.
   

  

 You will lead and drive Givaudan’s global HR agenda for the SAMEA region with a key focus on strategic talent outcomes. You will partner and provide relevant expertise in Talent Acquisition, Talent Management and Succession Planning, Compensation \& Benefits competitiveness, Diversity management and Employee Engagement to achieve important HR objectives.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Fragrance \& Beauty Global Head of HR and be based at our SAMEA Regional Head Office in Dubai Media City.
   

  

 You will work for a company that touches billions of consumers more than a hundred times a day. With its heritage stretching back over 250 years, Givaudan has a long history of innovating scents and tastes. Our passion is to collaborate with customers and partners to develop game\-changing innovations in the food \& beverage, fragrance and beauty industries. We have a culture that works to inspire, challenge and capture the heart and soul of consumers and customers. Our customers in the SAMEA region have local, regional, and international profiles, bringing diversity and curiosity to your daily job.
   

  

 Sounds interesting? It could well be your perfect opportunity to coach a diverse, multicultural region and team and support the continued building of a high\-performance team.
   

  

**In this exciting role, you will \-**
**HR Head for the SAMEA Regional Commercial and Operations organisations**
* As a member of the SAMEA Leadership Teams, you will be responsible for driving Givaudan's global HR agenda in the region, with a key focus on our Talent agenda (development, succession, talent acquisition, C\&B competitiveness, diversity, engagement).
* Development and execution of HR strategic deliverables that support the successful delivery of the region’s growth strategies.
* Be a dedicated HRBP for the SAMEA Commercial Heads and selected leaders/functions, such as Regional Innovation teams, driving their HR needs and in parallel acting as a coach, adviser and counsellor to the business stakeholders.


**Provide leadership to the SAMEA HR teams, both operationally and strategically**

* Focus on strong HR organisation development (Competencies, HR Talent, Business Partnering skills).
* Be a key member of the HR team (Corporate, Division, and Region) supporting the development and implementation of HR strategies and projects.
* Responsible for the HR Director responsibilities for the regional head office in Dubai.


**Coordination and alignment of HR deliverables and processes**
* Help with proactive inputs into the Global HR team agenda, sponsor HR team projects, and act as a member of the extended global HR team
* Drive alignment between local HR agendas and regional business and HR priorities
* Excellent partnership, coordination, and alignment with CoE HR teams and HR SAMEA teams on key HR processes, projects and issues.
* Manage local HR issues, compliance and partner with the local management committee to address and drive solutions with the local HR team to manage site\-specific challenges and issues.
* Support the acquisitions and integrations in SAMEA as applicable.


**You?**
* A relevant University degree. Specialisation in Human Resources is desirable.
* 15\+ years of relevant HR experience in a senior position.
* Experience in leading and building winning HR teams.
* Experience in HR business partnering roles in international and matrix organisation environments, ideally in both commercial and manufacturing setups.
* Experience managing employee relations challenges in the SAMEA region is desirable.
* Demonstrated experience and success in Talent Management and Acquisition, Leadership Development, Change Management, Organisational Effectiveness \& Diversity \& Inclusion.
* Excellent communication, influence and relationship\-building skills, inspiring trust and confidence from business stakeholders.
* Strong project management and execution skills.
* Can travel within the SAMEA region as needed.


**Our Benefits \-**
* Excellent opportunities for progressive learning and development.
* A creative team environment that will inspire you.
* Attractive compensation package.
* Private VIP health insurance for self and eligible dependents\*.
* Support for childrens’ education\*.
* Annual flight ticket allowance for self and eligible dependents\*.
* Performance bonus\*.


*(\* As per company policy)*
 At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.
   

  

 We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.
   

  

 Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.
   

  

 Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

 The Senior Architect has a direct reporting line to the Head of Architecture but is also accountable (dotted reporting line) to the Delivery Head \& Lead (aka Matrix Manager) in the business/functional domain that is being served. The Senior Architect is expected to possess deep technical expertise, potential leadership qualities \& be solution oriented with a core focus on contributing to build products that balance Functional Requirements, Customer/User Experience, Performance, Reliability, Resiliency \& Security.

* Agile Deliverables such as Features, Epics, Stories \& Acceptance Criteria

 5\+ years of experience building end\-end design patterns, high level designs \& solutions for applications (backend and frontend, including mobile apps), APIs, message brokers, event\-streams, microservices on container\-based / cloud\-native infrastructure and its associated ecosystem in consultation with involved internal departments and subsidiaries.

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

**Competitive Salary**
