**About The Role**
**Who are we**
 At Balio Software we acquire and scale niche B2B software companies worldwide, bridging the gap between traditional software stability and AI innovation. Our team consists of successful SaaS founders and investors who have accelerated companies into high\-performing businesses. Today, we are driving systemic change across our portfolio by deploying an AI\-first mindset. By integrating advanced AI solutions into the companies we purchase, we elevate market value and sharpen value propositions, enabling businesses to excel as agile, efficient, and modern organisations. We are operators at our core, powered by the future of intelligence.
   

  

**The role**
 Balio is hiring a Head of Portfolio Engineering to set the technical direction for our portfolio of acquired software businesses and build the engineering function that will scale with us. This is a hands\-on leadership role that sits at group level; working across every product and team in our portfolio, you'll raise the quality bar, consolidate infrastructure, and give our engineering teams the tools and standards to build AI\-native by default. This is a fully remote role and you will work with teams across multiple time zones (AEST to PST).
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Engineering leadership across all portfolio companies, setting the technical direction, quality bar, and operating cadence.
* Hiring, developing, and holding accountable engineering leads at each portfolio company; building a bench of talent across the group.
* Driving an AI\-first engineering approach, identifying where AI tooling, automation, and agents can accelerate product delivery and reduce manual overhead.
* Partnering with portfolio company GMs to translate business goals into technical roadmaps.
* Serving as the primary escalation point for engineering risk, architecture decisions, and major technical investments across the portfolio.
* Running a lightweight shared services function where applicable \- identifying where tooling, infrastructure, or practices can be standardised across companies.
* Reporting directly to the Head of Portfolio you will serve as the technical lead within the Balio leadership team.


**Who You Are**
* A senior engineering leader \- you've run engineering teams of 15\+ people and know what good looks like across the full SDLC. Strong preference for experience managing across multiple teams.
* Broadly technically credible \- across SDLC, architecture, infrastructure, and delivery, with strong mentorship and decision\-support capability.
* Operationally sharp \- comfortable managing across multiple products/companies simultaneously, with strong prioritisation instincts.
* An AI native \- you use AI tools daily, you think about how to embed them in engineering workflows, and you hold a genuine conviction that AI changes how software gets built. The focus is practical productivity gains, not buzzword\-led initiatives.
* A strong communicator \- able to translate technical complexity for commercial stakeholders and vice versa.
* Comfortable with ambiguity \- this role is being built; the right person will shape it.


**Background we'd expect**
* 10\+ years in software engineering, with 4\+ years in an engineering leadership role (VP Eng, Head of Engineering, or equivalent).
* Experience in a multi\-product or portfolio environment preferred (PE\-backed, holding company, or venture studio).
* Track record of improving engineering velocity and quality in acquired or turnaround businesses.
* Experience shipping measurable quality or productivity gains using AI assisted workflows


 By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
 Based at our Corporate Office in Dubai, the Senior Legal Counsel is responsible to provide support and assistance in relation to all aspects of DP World \- Maritime Solutions business activities with the focus on shipping transactional work (charter\-parties, financing, sale \& purchase, new\-builds, vessel flagging, regulatory, insurance, corporate, JVs) plus disputes/litigation.
   

  

 The Senior Legal Counsel will provide high quality, targeted and accessible legal advice across a range of maritime practice areas and will work as a valued business partner with colleagues across DP World \- Maritime Solutions in order to secure and deliver effective solutions to legal issues. The Senior Legal Counsel will need to be highly experienced and technically proficient in their areas of maritime legal specialism and also act as the senior in\-house expert for a specific practice discipline e.g. arbitration, ship finance, Sale \& Purchase, vessel flagging. They will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy on complex legal matters. The Senior Legal Counsel will lead and manage their own portfolio of matters, but they will also work collegiately with rest of the legal team and Head of Legal on larger legal projects, particularly those which require input from multiple specialisms or experience. The Senior Legal Counsel will also assist in and supervise the work of the Junior Legal Counsel and Paralegals in the legal team.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* The Senior Legal Counsel will lead and manage their own portfolio of matters, with need for minimal supervision by Head of Legal
* Act as lead counsel in transactions and advise the Group in all legal issues regarding the ownership and operation of DP World \- Maritime Solutions vessels and vessel owning companies in the company Group to mitigate risk and align matters with DP World \- Maritime Solutions policy and capacity, in particular:
* Act as lead to Prepare, review and negotiate charter party contracts, vessel acquisition and disposal contracts, including related tax and insurance matters.
* Act as lead on legal material to and review tenders and bid proposals contracts, including drafting and reviewing NDA, LOI, MOU.
* Act as lead on Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating shipbuilding contracts including completion of delivery and registration formalities.
* Act as lead on Reviewing financial \& loan agreements, including assisting on loan documentation and ensure compliance with loan covenants.
* Act as lead in preparation and review of joint venture, collaboration and alliance agreements.
* Act as lead on general contracts, including IT, procurement, and labour related contracts.
* Act as lead on maritime insurance claims with nominated insurance brokers and insurance underwriters when necessary.
* Take a lead role in administering the legal framework and compliance requirements of the organization to ensure continuity of business and appropriate company corporate structure.
* Identify strategic legal requirements and initiatives from time to time, and drive these with need for minimal supervision.
* Act as lead counsel and work with Finance/Tax team to Identify tax implications for business activities and implement structures to handle required tax implications, including preparation and review of agreements between entities within the DP World \- Maritime Solutions incorporating applicable transfer pricing principles.
* Act as lead counsel and work with Finance/Tax team to optimize and oversee the corporate structure of the DP World \- Maritime Solutions Group including establishment of new companies and closure of companies where determined, including taking lead role in preparing corporate documents, loan agreements, shareholder and board documents.
* Act as lead counsel to evaluate and determine whether external legal advice is required, prepare briefing material for external providers of legal services and advise relevant internal department on such matters. Act as focal point with external lawyers and the P\&I Club on matters/disputes being handled externally.
* Act as lead in Drafting and revision of Company standard agreements and other legal documents as required.
* Act as lead in Drafting and revision of internal control routines and procedures.
* Act as lead to Coordinate and monitor litigation/other proceedings to which the Company is party or potentially party.
* Assist, advise and support the Head of Legal on ad hoc work as necessary.
* Delegate work to, work with and supervise Paralegals and Junior Counsels.
* Leading by example as a senior role model for DP World \- Maritime Solutions’ values and professional standards.
* Driving the delivery of business and corporate plans for the senior legal counsel’s own areas of responsibility.
* Driving continuous improvement within the senior legal counsel’s own areas of responsibility.
* Taking a proactive approach to risk management, ensuring risks and issues are identified, addressed and reported and, where appropriate, escalated.
* Work as lead counsel with DPW/P\&O insurance and risk management team to ensure risks are adequately addressed, understood and insured.
* Being fully aware of and actively complying with DP World \- Maritime Solutions and DPW’s policies and procedures relevant to the senior legal counsel’s own responsibilities and to corporate policies and procedure.


**Minimum Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIION \& EXPERIENCE**
* Bachelor’s degree in law
* Master’s degree in marine law or Contract law preferable


**Minimum Experience**
* 10 (TEN) years’ experience in a related field or equivalent training or experience. Must have good knowledge of contract law and
* English /common Law and shipping law
* Dependable and able to deliver contributions with little direction.


**Key Attributes**
* Excellent written, drafting and oral communication skills with fluency in English.
* Detail oriented, hands‐on, driven and able to cope with demanding deadlines.
* Focus on quality and efficiency, with positive commitment to EHSQ.
* Some disputes and compliance experience (sanctions, GDPR, anti\-bribery) will be considered a plus.
* Transaction and project management skills.


**About Us**
**ABOUT THE BUSINESS**
 P\&O Maritime Logistics (POML) is a leading provider of marine solutions with focus on offshore energy, port services and logistics. The company provides a wide portfolio of value\-added marine services and ability to integrate these offerings for its customers – always with safety and the environment at the forefront.
   

  

 Headquartered in Dubai, the company has operations globally across all seven continents.
   

  

 In July 2019, Topaz Energy and Marine was acquired by DP World, merged with P\&O Maritime and started operating under the P\&O brand as P\&O Maritime Logistics.
   

  

 www.pomaritime.com

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**GEMS Wellington Academy – Al Khail is seeking to appoint an outstanding Head of Business and Economics from August 2026\.** 
 The successful candidate will lead a high\-performing department, ensuring excellent teaching, strong academic outcomes and a curriculum that prepares students for future pathways.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Head of Business and Economics provides strategic and operational leadership of the department across Key Stages 4 and 5\. The role focuses on delivering a high\-quality curriculum, supporting staff development and ensuring all students achieve their full potential.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Lead curriculum planning, delivery and review across Business, Economics and vocational courses.
* Ensure high\-quality teaching and consistent standards across the department.
* Monitor and analyse student progress, implementing targeted interventions where needed.
* Oversee assessment processes, including BTEC verification and exam preparation.
* Lead, support and develop teaching staff, including coaching and performance management.
* Promote a collaborative team culture with high expectations for staff and students.
* Engage with parents through reporting and school events.
* Develop links with universities, industry and external partners.
* Contribute to school self\-evaluation, inspection readiness and improvement planning.
* Support whole\-school priorities including literacy, inclusion and digital learning.
* Promote enrichment opportunities and support student career pathways.


**Skills**
* Proven leadership experience within a secondary school setting.
* Strong subject knowledge in Business and/or Economics.
* Excellent understanding of the British curriculum and assessment frameworks.
* Strong communication, organisational and leadership skills.
* Ability to inspire and develop both students and staff.
* Recognised teaching qualification (PGCE or equivalent).
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant subject; further qualifications desirable.


**GEMS Education is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all of its students and staff. A UK\-enhanced DBS or equivalent police check is a pre\-requisite for all appointments.**

Keen to become part of a truly global, collaborative team of professionals? Your journey begins here.
   

  

**Job title**
 Marketing and Business Development Adviser – Middle East
   

  

**Department**
 Marketing \& Business Development
   

  

**Location**
 Dubai
   

  

**Reports To**
 Director of M\&BD – EMEA
   

  

**Working Hours**
 40 hours per week, 9am to 6pm, Monday to Friday. Additional hours may be required.
   

  

****Firm Description****
 Hogan Lovells is a leading global law firm. Our distinctive market position is founded on our exceptional breadth of our practice, on deep industry knowledge, and on our 'one team' global approach. Formed through the combination of two top international law firms, Hogan Lovells has over 40 offices in the Americas, Asia\-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
   

  

 With a presence in the world's major financial and commercial markets, we are well placed to provide excellent business\-oriented advice to our clients locally and internationally. Our people are the key to our success, which is why we seek to recruit and retain the most talented individuals in all regions of our global practice.
   

  

****Department Description****
 We have a well\-established global M\&BD and Corporate Communications team, which supports the firm on a wide range of business development, client relationship management and reputational activities. The function is divided into several key areas including Practice M\&BD, Sector M\&BD, Regional M\&BD, Client Development, Corporate Communications, which comprises Public Relations, Brand, Design, Events, and Digital; Pitches, Pursuits and Business Intelligence; and M\&BD Operations \& Systems.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 The Marketing and Business Development (M\&BD) Adviser in Dubai will work closely with the M\&BD Manager in Riyadh and our Head of M\&BD for the Middle East, as well as with the local lawyers in Dubai. They will also support the wider Middle East Practice Group (MEPG). They will manage the delivery of projects and goals identified in both the Middle East business plan, EMEA business plan and in line with the firm’s global strategic goals.
   

  

 The role will encompass the full range of business development and marketing activities including: pitching, credentials and other marketing collateral; client targeting and cross\-selling; client/sector and competitor analysis; profile raising and marketing campaigns including communications such as directory submissions, online content (intranet, hoganlovells.com, social media), and BD evaluation.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Pitches and credentials**
* Managing responses to RFPs, proposals for specific opportunities and credentials whilst ensuring the best practice pitch approach is applied. This includes researching relevant market, industry, competitive, and business information for the preparation of successful pitches.
* Collaborate with other administrative functions within the firm, including the finance team, pricing team, compliance team, and the general counsel’s office, to ensure alignment and gathering of relevant information for pitch completion.
* Write and produce other bespoke materials, including client presentations.
* Collate and maintain information on the firm wide pitch system, monitor success rates and make recommendations for improvements.
* Undertake and maintain post pitch feedback where appropriate.


**Client targeting and development**
* Support the Dubai practice teams on client relationship management initiatives.
* Champion client listening/feedback, including identifying client listening/feedback opportunities and conducting client listening/feedback interviews, ensuring that best practice principles are embedded across the practice and feedback is acted on.


**Infrastructure and marketing systems**
* Collate information and maintain pitches/proposals, credentials, intranet/web content, etc. and leverage firm systems.
* Maintain and regularly analyse key M\&BD information systems and library of materials centrally including the pitch log, intranet, hoganlovells.com, credentials.
* Encourage full and effective use of the firm’s CRM database (InterAction) and other infrastructure and marketing systems (e.g. iPublish, Engage/Our Thinking, our Finance Hub and IntroHive).
* Provide input and support on the firm’s experience management system, Foundation.


**Profile raising and marketing campaigns**
* Co\-ordinate, shape and deliver local client events/seminars. Tasks include (but not limited to) mailing list creation, event promotion, management of in\-person or online event logistics, and development of invitations and other client communications.
* Lead on the development of local practice area entries in directories, award submissions and legal supplements.
* Write, edit and produce marketing communications including e.g. internal and external newsletters, thought leadership and web copy.
* Liaise and collaborate with other M\&BD teams and PR to cross\-sell capabilities and credentials including proactively coordinating with PR to raise the profile of individual partners and go\-to\-market propositions/products.
* Support the M\&BD team in marketing programs, thought leadership campaigns and social media efforts to raise the profile of our practices in Dubai.


**Wider BD initiatives**
* Contribute to the wider Middle East projects as required.
* Deal with ad hoc enquiries about the Dubai practice or its clients from other parts of the firm or members of the M\&BD team.
* Participate in our Responsible Business program.
* Any other tasks that may reasonably be required.


*Specific duties or responsibilities may be reviewed from time to time to reflect changes in personnel and management structure, staff location or services*
**Person Specification**
**Essential**
 Skills \& Experience
   

  

* Previous experience in working in a business development/marketing environment, ideally in Dubai/the Middle East.
* A solid understanding of the commercial world and its drivers.
* A solid understanding of marketing and business development processes.
* A keen interest in self\-development and bags of initiative.
* A proactive team player with a 'can do attitude'.
* Ability to create a positive impact with colleagues, peers, partners and clients and to demonstrate diplomacy, listening and influencing skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a keen eye for detail and the ability to write in a compelling way.
* Effective project management skills including the ability to plan ahead and prioritise conflicting demands to meet deadlines for the team.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure.
* An understanding of the firm's business and marketplace.
* Experience of, and comfortable in, a partnership or equivalent professional services environment.


 Desired
   

  

* Prior knowledge and experience of working in a law firm role would be advantageous.
* A general understanding of the legal market (in terms of key players and product areas) to aid familiarity with terminology and to add as much value as possible when talking with partners.


**Essential**
 Qualifications \& Training
   

  

* Candidates must be educated to graduate level and hold a good degree or equivalent from a reputable institution.
* Four to five years of relevant experience.


 Desired
   

  

* A relevant marketing or sales qualification, such as the CIM or equivalent.


 Equal Opportunities Employment Statement
   

  

 It is the policy of Hogan Lovells to provide equal opportunities for all employees in relation to recruitment, training and promotion. Decisions in these areas will be made only by reference to the requirements of the job and shall not be influenced by any consideration of racial or ethnic origin, religion, sex, gender and gender identity, age, sexual orientation, marital and civil partnership status, pregnancy or disability.
   

  

 All vacancies are open to direct applicants. Recruitment agencies; please be advised that we have a preferred supplier list in place for all roles.

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.


**Disclaimer:** 
 Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

 • Design lesson sequences that build understanding in the right order and improve student results

 • Create short\-form video content for platforms such as TikTok to build trust, grow reach, and drive engagement

 • A\-Level Further Maths specialist with deep subject knowledge and strong instinct for where students struggle

 • Online tutoring experience is highly desirable
 



 • Strong grasp of exam requirements, mark schemes, and assessment style in Further Maths
 



 • Examiner experience is highly desirable
 



 • Excellent teacher and communicator who explains difficult ideas in a simple, engaging way
 



 • Strong on camera and confident presenting to students and parents
 



 • Proven track record of helping students secure top grades
 



 • Able to build both deep subject understanding and strong exam technique
 



 • Creative, commercially aware, and comfortable working in a fast\-moving digital education business
 



 • Clear spoken and written English is essential
 



  





**Why Join EdGenie** 




  





 • Join a fast\-growing EdTech company with strong ambition and real momentum
 



 • Play a leading role in shaping our A\-Level Further Maths offering
 



 • Work with a team focused on impact, standards, and student results
 



 • Hybrid role based in Dubai
 



 • Competitive pay with performance incentives
 



 • Professional production support to help your content perform at a high level

**How to Apply** 




  





 If you are an exceptional A\-Level Further Maths teacher, tutor, content creator, or examiner and want to help build one of the strongest Further Maths offerings in the market, we want to hear from you.
 



  





 📩 Apply with your CV and send a message explaining why you are a strong fit for the role.
 



  





 Join EdGenie and help students secure top grades through expert teaching, sharp exam technique, and high\-impact content.

data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Product Management (Pricing \& Assurance)
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard’s Transfer Solutions team in EEMEA is driving at scale innovation and growth to meet today’s demands for simple, certain, and secure international and domestic payments by individuals and businesses of all sizes. Mastercard Move is a portfolio of integrated assets and capabilities designed to service key verticals, customer segments and multiple payment flows. Through simple connectivity means, we enable partners the ability to reach a variety of endpoints—account, card, mobile wallet, cards and cash out locations —nearly anywhere in the world.
   

  

 The organization is looking for a Director, Product Management (Pricing \& Assurance), Mastercard Move as part of the EEMEA Product Management Team for Cross Border Payments, to work with customers, who are primarily large Financial Institutions, Fin Techs, Bureau De Changes / Exchange Houses or Government Clearing Schemes to further the strategic and commercial agenda of Mastercard in the region focused on Cross Border Payments, which includes Low Value B2B / Commercial Payments, P2P Remittances and Purpose\-based payments like Bill Payments, Tuition Payments, Utility, Social Security etc.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is aware of the Cross\-Border Payments landscape and is aware of the intricate dynamics of how money moves between Institutions and Borders, being familiar with the role Correspondent and Bilateral Banking arrangements play in the setup, the evolving nature of SWIFT (and its evolution to ISO messaging standards), existing Settlement \& Funding mediums, helping to identify the gaps and solutionize areas where Mastercard’s own and partner led solutions can add value.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* This is a Pricing and Assurance role at its heart where you will work with Product Sales teams / Account Managers to ensure we are able to provide best commercial value to our customers alongside safeguarding long\-term financial interests for the company.
* Often, you would work with customers directly to help them formulate the right value story / financial model to ensure the product is able to provide the best Value Proposition to our clients and their customers.
* Prepare / facilitate complex business cases within Mastercard at a customer / deal / portfolio level to ensure the right investments / financial support / prioritization is done for opportunities worth the merit.
* Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle for the business, and partner with Finance colleagues upstream and Sales colleagues downstream to ensure we can project and hit the business numbers.
* Formulate and track underlying business driver and enabler metrics on weekly / fortnightly / monthly level with cross\-functional teams – including delivery timelines, growth rates etc. as relevant.
* Executive presentation outlining business direction and facilitation of QBR / MBR with senior leaders and often with strategic clients. Partner for strategy refresh cycles to evaluate what’s working v/s not.
* Act as PMO for key internal work\-streams which affects revenue realization – like Network health and breadth, FX constructs, Deal Incentive structures etc.


**All About You**
 The ideal candidate for this position should:
   

  

* Understands cross\-border payments at its’ core and the lever(s) that influence the commercial health of the product and the business at large.
* Understanding of financial and reporting principles of key metrices that influence business development.
* Be able to work horizontally in a highly matrixed organization with overlapping ownership and influence. Be able to get the work done through influence, reasoning rather than authority.
* Very strong with Excel and PowerPoint as that would effectively be 70% of your work – pricing, governance, reporting.
* Strong communicator and have the temperament to be able to lead client facing conversations independently.
* If you have done a pricing role in the past in the industry – it’s a plus. Product FP\&A candidates may also be fit with extension.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 280\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Director – AI Change \& Adoption.** 
 The role holder is responsible for leading a transformational AI enablement mandate across Dubai Holding Group and its subsidiary entities. Sitting within Group Strategy, the Director – AI Change \& Adoption partners with business leaders, People \& Culture functions, and technology teams across all entities to define and deliver an AI adoption agenda that changes the way people work, think, and collaborate at scale. The role is pivotal in building the capabilities needed to thrive in an AI\-first world — spanning real estate, hospitality, entertainment, investment and media verticals — and ensuring that innovation in artificial intelligence translates into measurable shifts in workforce behaviour, culture, and commercial performance.
 



  





 If you are driven by integrity, curiosity, and a passion for uncovering insights that shape better decisions, we would be delighted to connect with you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**AI Adoption Strategy** 




 • Develop and own the Group\-wide AI adoption strategy, covering Microsoft Copilot, Claude (Anthropic), Palantir Foundry, and other enterprise AI tools, ensuring coherent adoption across all Group companies
 



 • Define phased roadmaps that sequence capability building, tool deployment, and cultural change across diverse business entities
 



 • Identify, prioritise, and validate AI use cases that deliver measurable commercial, operational, and workforce productivity outcomes
 



  





**Microsoft Partnership \& Rollouts** 




 • Lead the planning and execution of large\-scale Microsoft technology implementations, including programmes with a Microsoft investment or co\-delivery component
 



 • Work closely with Microsoft account teams and internal stakeholders to maximise value from the strategic partnership, including co\-investment, co\-sell, and funded deployment arrangements
 



 • Oversee governance of Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Azure\-based adoption programmes across Group entities
 



  





**Change Management** 




 • Design and lead large\-scale change programmes that drive measurable shifts in workforce behaviour, embedding AI tools into everyday workflows rather than treating them as standalone initiatives
 



 • Apply structured change methodologies to manage resistance, build readiness, and sustain adoption through transition
 



 • Champion a human\-centred approach to AI transformation, balancing innovation with workforce wellbeing and ethical stewardship
 



  





**Culture \& Engagement** 




 • Build an AI\-centric growth culture across diverse entities — defining the mindsets, norms, and leadership behaviours that allow AI adoption to take root and scale
 



 • Design and execute internal communications and engagement campaigns that create excitement, reduce fear, and drive sustained participation across large, distributed workforces
 



 • Foster a culture of transparency and shared purpose by communicating the impact of AI initiatives on individual and enterprise KPIs
 



  





**Capability Building** 




 • Commission, design, and oversee AI literacy and upskilling programmes tailored to different workforce segments, from frontline employees to senior executives
 



 • Partner with People \& Culture functions to embed AI skills development into talent frameworks, performance management, and career pathways
 



 • Establish communities of practice and peer learning networks to sustain capability growth beyond formal programmes
 



  





**Data \& Insight** 




 • Use platforms such as Palantir Foundry, Power BI, and other analytics tools to measure adoption, identify gaps, and demonstrate the ROI of the human capital investment in AI
 



 • Define and track key adoption metrics, including usage rates, productivity uplift, and behavioural change indicators, reporting to senior leadership on a regular cadence
 



 • Apply data\-driven insights to prioritise interventions and course\-correct programme delivery in real time
 



  





**Stakeholder Engagement** 




 • Influence and align Entity CEOs, Technology Directors, Heads of HR, and Group leadership on priorities, progress, and investment cases for AI enablement
 



 • Serve as the principal thought leader and trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on AI adoption, change management, and workforce transformation
 



 • Lead high\-impact steering committees and strategic planning sessions to surface synergies and unlock Group\-wide value from AI investment
 



  





**Governance \& Frameworks** 




 • Establish policies, frameworks, and accountability structures that sustain AI adoption beyond the initial rollout phase
 



 • Define and enforce governance standards for responsible AI use, including compliance, explainability, and ethical considerations across all workforce touchpoints
 



 • Develop and maintain a Group\-wide AI adoption playbook, capturing lessons learned and best practices for scaling across entities
 



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




 • 8\-10 years of experience in organisational change, IT transformation, or people\-led digital transformation
 



 • Proven track record of driving AI or technology adoption at scale in large, complex organisations
 



 • Strong experience delivering large\-scale Microsoft implementations — including Microsoft 365, Copilot, or Azure\-based programmes — ideally in organisations with a formal Microsoft investment or strategic partnership arrangement
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot, Claude/Anthropic tools, Palantir Foundry or equivalent enterprise AI platforms
 



 • Familiarity with data and analytics platforms such as Palantir Foundry, Power BI, Splunk, etc.
 



 • Prior experience working across multi\-entity or conglomerate structures; experience in the UAE or wider GCC is preferred
 



 • Arabic language skills strongly preferred
 



  





**Education / Professional Certifications:** 




**Minimum:** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Business, Organisational Psychology, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related field
 



**Preferred:** 




 • Master's degree (MBA, MSc in Organisational Change, Digital Transformation, or related discipline) from a recognised institution
 



 • Relevant certifications in change management (e.g., Prosci, APMG) or Microsoft technology programmes
 



  





**Technical Competencies:** 




 • Proven ability to translate AI and technology strategy into pragmatic, phased delivery plans within complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
 



 • Exceptional campaign design and communications skills — able to inspire and mobilise at every level of the organisation
 



 • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to build investment cases, measure impact, and report ROI to senior leadership
 



 • Culturally fluent — experienced working across diverse, multinational teams in the UAE or wider GCC
 



 • Adept at navigating vendor relationships, particularly with large technology partners such as Microsoft and Palantir
 



 • Data\-driven decision\-maker — uses evidence to prioritise, course\-correct, and demonstrate value
 



 • Key platforms: Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft 365, Azure, Claude (Anthropic), Palantir Foundry, Power BI, Splunk
 



  





**Behavioral Competencies:** 




 • Taking and Sustaining
 



 • Strategic Thinking
 



 • Delivering Excellence
 



 • Positive Leadership
 



  





 As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.
 



  





**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are a global Immersive Aerial Experience Studio transitioning from a drone\-light\-show startup to a premium, multi\-technology entertainment company. We operate across the Middle East, Europe, and the Americas, selling highly customized, six\-figure ($50k \- $100k\+) shows to corporate entities, governments, and mega\-event organizers.
   

  

 We are seeking a "Brand \& Growth Hybrid" to lead our global marketing. You must possess the creative "eye" to maintain our premium, luxury aesthetic across visual channels (like Instagram), while possessing the analytical "math" to build a rigorous B2B demand\-generation funnel. You will direct an existing 6\-person creative and performance team, shifting their output from "B2C awareness" to targeted, revenue\-generating B2B campaigns.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 The "Luxury Storefront" (Brand Validation \& Creative Direction)
   

  

* Creative Quality Control: Act as the "Brand Guardian." Direct our videographers and designers to ensure every Instagram Reel, YouTube video, and pitch deck feels like a luxury service that justifies a $50,000 \- $100,000\+ price tag
* The Visual Portfolio: Strategically own our Instagram and visual platforms. Ensure they serve as the ultimate, high\-end portfolio that instantly validates our credibility when a VIP client looks us up after a sales pitch
* Global Localization: Adapt our visual and written brand for different cultural touchpoints, seamlessly managing localized campaigns for Dubai, Brazil, and Europe in multiple languages


 The "VIP Sales Engine" (B2B Demand Generation \& ToFu Steering)
   

  

* Sales Alignment: Work directly with the CEO and (regional) Sales Director to define Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs). Transform the marketing department into a Top\-of\-Funnel (ToFu) machine that feeds the sales team
* Targeted Campaign Execution: Oversee the performance marketer to run highly targeted Meta and Google ad campaigns aimed specifically at B2B decision\-makers (Event Directors, PR Agencies, Government Tourism Boards)
* Metrics \& ROI: Shift to Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), and overall pipeline revenue generated
* Market Intelligence \& Expansion: Identify new markets, analyze customer segments, and monitor competitors to support strategic expansion and strengthen Cyberdrone’s global market position


 Executive Thought Leadership, PR, \& Events
   

  

* Personal Branding: Manage the LinkedIn presence and personal branding of the CEO and key Sales Team members, positioning them as international thought leaders in immersive entertainment technology
* High\-Value B2B Channels: Pivot focus toward channels that close enterprise deals: secure speaking slots at major industry panels, negotiate PR placements in event\-industry trade magazines, and strategize direct\-mail/face\-to\-face VIP events and exhibition presence

**Technical Requirements \& Skills**
* The "Dual\-Brain" Marketer: Must demonstrate both high\-end creative taste (video/design direction) and rigorous analytical skills (CRM data, ROI calculation, ad\-spend optimization)
* B2B / Enterprise Experience: Proven track record of marketing high\-ticket services or products. You know how to market to a corporate Board or a major event agency
* Team Leadership: Experience managing and extracting the best work from creative specialists (videographers, designers, writers)
* Multichannel Fluency: Deep understanding of how to take one core piece of content (e.g., a drone show recap video) and adapt it for Instagram (brand), LinkedIn (lead gen), and PR (authority)

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
* 7–10 years of marketing experience, including a senior or leadership role
* Proven experience in B2B marketing and demand generation, preferably for high\-value services or technology
* Strong track record in brand development combined with revenue\-driven marketing
* Experience working closely with sales teams and managing enterprise sales funnels
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing a marketing team
* Analytical mindset with experience using data and KPIs to guide strategy
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director, Residential Portfolio Management is responsible for the portfolio‑level governance, planning, and setup of branded residential components across Kerzner’s global Private Homes and Branded Residences development pipeline.
   

  

 The role focuses on the pre‑opening residential lifecycle, from early pre‑development and planning through to opening, providing structured management and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The objective is to ensure that all branded residential projects are consistently defined, correctly configured, brand‑aligned, and operationally ready for structured handover to OpCo at opening.
   

  

 The position acts as the residential portfolio authority, establishing and managing residential project stage gates, defining residential requirements and standards, and validating outcomes at key milestones to ensure quality, consistency, and readiness across a growing pipeline of residential projects. The role does not include responsibility for day‑to‑day operations, rental programs, or HOA governance, which sit outside of this position.
   

  

 The role requires a strong background in luxury hospitality‑led residential product, portfolio oversight, and cross‑functional coordination, with the ability to translate brand intent and residential requirements into repeatable, scalable outcomes across multiple projects and geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Governance \& Residential Frameworks** 
  

  

* Establish, own, and maintain portfolio‑wide residential frameworks, standards, and setup playbooks for all branded residential and Private Homes projects.
* Define, document, and maintain Kerzner side residential requirements and performance principles to inform the design and delivery of branded residential projects across the portfolio.
* Establish minimum portfolio requirements (not design solutions) covering:
+ Unit mix and typology principles (performance intent and target ranges, not layouts)
+ Residential amenity principles, including owner only vs shared use positioning
+ Arrival, circulation, privacy, and access requirements, expressed as outcomes rather than spatial solutions
+ Back of house and servicing requirements necessary to support efficient future operation and homeowner experience
+ Residential technology readiness criteria, defining capability requirements rather than system design

* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of branded residential standards across all projects and geographies.


**Residential Project Stage Gates (Portfolio Control)** 
  

  

* Establish and manage Residential Project Stage Gates aligned with the wider development lifecycle.
* Define required residential inputs and outputs at each stage, including:
+ Deal feasibility / concept confirmation
+ Concept design
+ Schematic design
+ Design development (residential “red‑flag” review)
+ Design and Build Phase
+ Pre‑opening residential readiness
+ Handover to OpCo

* Act as the Kerzner residential authority at each stage gate by:
+ Validating compliance with portfolio standards and residential requirements
+ Identifying material risks, gaps, or deviations
+ Confirming readiness to progress from a residential perspective

* Maintain a portfolio‑level record of residential stage‑gate reviews, approvals, and deviations
* Present stage gate readiness to all key internal stakeholders.


**Pre‑Development \& Planning (Residential Input)** 
  

  

* Provide residential subject‑matter input during pre‑development and early planning phases of new branded residential opportunities.
* Support Business Development and Design and Construction teams with residential assessments relating to:
+ Brand alignment and positioning
+ High‑level residential scope and feasibility assumptions
+ Unit mix strategy, typologies, and sizing logic
+ Amenity positioning and residential value proposition
+ Preliminary operational and governance implications

* Define early residential product principles to inform project briefs prior to design commencement.
* Identify and mitigate early‑stage risks that could impact:
+ Residential liveability and owner experience
+ Long‑term asset and portfolio value
+ Operational viability and handover readiness

* Ensure residential planning decisions align with a scalable, repeatable portfolio strategy.


**Design \& Project Interface (Residential Input Only)**
* Provide structured residential input to Design and Project teams at defined project milestones.
* Review residential layouts, adjacencies, circulation, and functional planning from an owner, operator readiness, and portfolio perspective.
* Ensure residential requirements and assumptions are clearly documented and integrated into the design process.
* Monitor design evolution to prevent unintended deviations that may negatively affect residential quality or long‑term usability.
* Maintain a collaborative, non‑authoring relationship with Design, respecting design leadership and consultant ownership.


**Brand Compliance \& Residential Product Integrity** 
  

  

* Ensure branded residential standards are interpreted and applied consistently across the portfolio.
* Review key residential elements impacting brand equity and owner experience, including:
+ Finishes intent and durability
+ Amenity positioning and exclusivity
+ Privacy, acoustics, and spatial separation

* Monitor and document residential deviations, concessions, and approved exceptions.
* Provide portfolio‑level insight into recurring issues and lessons learned across projects.


**Residential Operating Model \& Operating Plan Development**
* Define the Residential Operating Model and develop a structured Residential Operating Plan (ROP) for each project during the planning phase
* Ensure the defined residential operating plan is fully supported by design and asset configuration, validating that back‑of‑house layouts, access, storage, plant capacity, service flows, and residential technology capabilities enable efficient, discreet, and brand‑appropriate operation.
* Validate residential operational readiness from a governance perspective, confirming the asset can be realistically operated as intended, that material operational risks, inefficiencies, or cost drivers are identified and mitigated early, and that the project is ready for OpCo acceptance without fundamental re‑planning
* Formally package and transition the Residential Operating Model to OpCo as part of pre‑opening and handover, ensuring clarity of intent, scope, and assumptions.


**Pre‑Opening \& Handover** 
  

  

* Coordinate with OpCo teams in advance of opening to support a smooth transition of responsibility.
* Lead residential readiness activities prior to opening from a portfolio and governance perspective.
* Ensure completion of all residential handover requirements, including obtaining TCO and OC, establishing asset and warranty register frameworks, completing residential handover checklists, and confirming owner move‑in readiness principles.
* Coordinate structured handover of residential assets to:
+ OpCo (operations)
+ Director of Residence

* Formally transition responsibility at opening, retaining oversight only for portfolio‑level tracking, consult level support and continuous improvement.


**Portfolio Reporting \& Stakeholder Coordination** 
  

  

* Maintain strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders including:
+ Design
+ Projects / Construction
+ Business Development
+ Property Management
+ OpCo

* Provide regular portfolio reporting on:
+ Residential pipeline status
+ Key risks and mitigation actions
+ Stage‑gate progress and readiness

* Support leadership decision‑making with clear, evidence‑based residential insights.


**Explicit Exclusions (Boundary Clarity)**
* No responsibility for residential rental programs or leasing
* No day‑to‑day residential operations or staffing
* No HOA or residential governance management
* No design authorship or consultant management


**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Business, Hospitality Management, Architecture, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 8–10 years’ experience across branded residences, luxury mixed‑use developments, or hospitality‑led residential platforms.
* Strong understanding of branded residential product, owner expectations, and residential lifecycle planning.
* Proven experience working at portfolio level across multiple concurrent projects.
* Ability to influence across Design, Development, Projects, Operations, and Property Management without direct authority.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills with ability to manage complexity across geographies.
* Comfortable operating in an owner‑side, non‑operational, governance‑focused role.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; strong Excel skills preferred.
* Fluent in English; additional languages advantageous.

Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, with additional regional and global support offices.
   

  

**Your Role**
 This role requires you to be a Swiss Army knife. It'll engage every skill you have and make your brain cells perk up—left brain, right brain, and muscles you didn't know you had.
   

  

 If you're the type who enjoys building the plane while it's flying, this is your seat. We're a brand\-new comms department, inside a 1,000\-person scale\-up operating across multiple offices and time zones.
   

  

 There's structure where it matters and space to build it where it doesn't exist yet.You'll help shape how we work, not just execute what's already there.
   

  

 We're in charge of crafting the company's narrative and ensuring it's clear, consistent, and visible across all our stakeholders: customers, partners, media, talent, investors, regulators, and more.We're looking for a PMO Specialist to help run, coordinate, and deliver the work that keeps our Communications function moving forward.

**Your expertise**

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated success working in diverse, high\-impact teams, with the ability to bridge gaps between different departments to drive collective progress.
* Exceptional Communication: Expert\-level written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear, persuasive narratives for senior leadership.


**Mindset**

* Comfort with Ambiguity: You thrive in environments where the path isn’t clearly defined. You have a natural ability to create structure out of chaos.

**Independent Driver:** 
 You are a self\-starter who can navigate complex organizational structures to push progress forward, even when resources are constrained.

**About Us**
 The Luxury Closet is a company born in Dubai, the heart of luxury in the Arabian Peninsula, where we are redefining the world of luxury. We seek to challenge the norms and build a sustainable company that is loved and admired, and inspires the modern\-day luxury consumer.
   

  

 Our aim is to unlock and curate the most valuable and exclusive closets from around the world.
   

  

 What do we offer?
   

  

* A young, dynamic and forward\-thinking environment
* Fast paced and very short decision times for changes
* A canvas for you to truly excel
* 99% of uptime on sunshine


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a dynamic, results\-driven
 **Riyadh Business Manager** 
 to lead our commercial growth and operational execution in Saudi Arabia. This role is the driving force behind our success in the region, requiring a leader who can balance high\-level business development with hands\-on operational management.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end client lifecycle and local logistics—from acquiring high\-value sellers and driving buyer revenue to overseeing product on boarding and managing shipments. If you are a versatile leader passionate about the luxury market, possessing a strong commercial mindset, and capable of running a seamless local operation to deliver a world\-class Net Promoter Score (NPS), this role is for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Seller Growth \& Supply Acquisition**
* Increase High\-Demand Supply: Formulate and execute strategies to acquire high\-value, highly desirable luxury items from sellers within Saudi Arabia.
* Seller Retention \& VIP Management: Build out retention programs to keep top\-tier sellers engaged, ensuring they consistently choose our platform for their luxury resale needs.
* Marketing Collaboration: Work closely with the regional marketing team to design, launch, and optimize targeted campaigns aimed at new seller acquisition.
* Conversion Optimization: Oversee the seller journey, identifying bottlenecks and training the sales team to improve conversion rates from initial inquiry to successful listing.


**Buyer Engagement \& Sales Leadership**
* Drive Buyer Revenue: Manage the Riyadh sales team to achieve and exceed regional revenue targets, focusing on high\-ticket conversions and repeat purchases.
* Cross\-Pollination: Develop initiatives to convert our top buyers into sellers, and our top sellers into buyers, maximizing the lifetime value of every Saudi client.
* Clienteling Excellence: Ensure the sales team is executing proactive, personalized outreach to VIP buyers to maintain top\-of\-mind brand awareness.


**Local Operations \& Logistics Management**
* Product On boarding \& Processing: Oversee the local item on boarding workflows. Ensure that high\-value supply is processed, verified, and prepped for listing with maximum efficiency and minimal turnaround time.
* Order \& Shipment Fulfilment: Manage end\-to\-end local logistics, including coordinating inbound shipments from sellers and outbound deliveries to buyers.
* Operational SLA \& Quality Control: Monitor operational KPIs to ensure strict adherence to service level agreements (SLAs), minimizing delays, shipping errors, and friction in the physical product journey.


**Team Management \& Client Experience**
* Lead and Coach: Manage, mentor, and scale the local Business Development, Sales, and Operations teams. Set clear KPIs, conduct regular performance reviews, and foster a high\-performance culture.
* NPS Champion: Own the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the KSA region. Monitor client feedback deeply across both sales interactions and operational fulfilment, implementing changes to ensure a flawless luxury experience.
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears on the ground. Report on local market trends, operational challenges, competitor activities, and shifting consumer behaviours to global leadership.


**Requirements**
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in Business Management, Business Development, or Operations, preferably within the luxury goods, e\-commerce, or premium retail sectors.
* Dual Skillset: Proven ability to manage both commercial sales / clienteling targets and physical operations/logistics workflows.
* Local Market Expertise: Deep understanding of the Saudi Arabian consumer and cultural nuances, with an existing network of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs) being a strong plus.
* Leadership: Proven track record of managing, coaching, and scaling cross\-functional teams to hit ambitious targets.
* Data\-Driven: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data (conversion rates, NPS, logistics SLAs, acquisition costs) to drive strategic decisions.


**Communication:** 
 Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills.
 ***Fluency in both Arabic and English is required.***

Who We Are
   

  

 At Inverto in Riyadh, we’re defining what’s next in procurement and supply chain—driven by ambition, precision, and impact. Growth at Inverto is shared growth\-opening new opportunities for our clients, our business, and our teams.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The Business \& Operations Senior Manager drives the effective operationalization of Inverto’s regional growth agenda by leading key commercial, people, financial, and operational processes for the Middle East.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go\-to\-market execution, and supports high\-quality decision\-making through robust performance and financial management. It plays a central role in shaping and sustaining talent and team development, driving a cohesive and high\-performing culture, and ensuring optimal staffing and resource allocation.
   

  

 The position also safeguards operational excellence by strengthening cross\-functional collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA, ensuring reliable data flow, and securing compliance with governance, legal, and internal standards. Additionally, it oversees local office operations and orchestrates shared services and marketing initiatives to enable seamless delivery and reinforce Inverto’s brand presence in the region.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role is ensuring alignment between BCG core and Inverto\-specific requirements, in accordance with Inverto’s global guardrails, and business model.
   

  

 Overall, the role is critical in enabling the Middle East business to operate effectively, grow sustainably, and achieve its strategic objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Management and GTM support
* Partner with Inverto Managing Directors, Principals, and Inverto EMESA to operationalize the Inverto growth plan and operating model by translating strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and effective execution

* Ensure smooth HR operations and benefits implementation in collaboration with local HR teams

* Ensure rigorous budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting, translating data into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
* Liaise with Inverto and BCG Finance teams to ensure accurate cost accounting and P\&L management against Plan
* Support Inverto Commercial Finance in maintaining full transparency of the project portfolio, enabling informed decision\-making on performance and risk management

* Ensure reliable information and data flow between Inverto Middle East and Inverto EMESA, including oversight of non\-automated processes and adherence to data governance standards
* Risk Management \& Compliance Coordination

* Ensure compliance with legal standards and internal policies, implementing effective local controls and maintaining transparency on regulatory updates
* Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up\-to\-date information on relevant compliance regulations
* Local Coordination \& Office Enablement
* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery
* Drive local marketing initiatives and ensure consistent execution of campaigns in alignment with global teams (Global Inverto Marketing and Global Employer Branding), maintaining a unified and compelling brand presence


 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelors or Masters degree with an above\-average grade.
   

  

 8\+ years of relevant experience within business operations
   

  

 Confident presence in an international environment, business fluent in English.
   

  

 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 Reporting to the Inverto Managing Director
   

  

 Working with global, regional and local teams
   

  

 Hyper motivated individuals
   

  

 Entrepreneurs and those that have a growth mindset
   

  

 Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

* Ability to work with cross\-cultural teams and diverse stakeholders.

**Job Description**

You will work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to monitor project performance, identify risks, and implement corrective actions that drive project success. * Develop, implement, and maintain integrated project control systems including schedule, budget, and resource management

* Identify schedule and budget variances, analyze root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions
* Prepare comprehensive project status reports, dashboards, and presentations for executive leadership and project teams
* Manage project change control processes, ensuring all modifications are properly documented, evaluated, and approved
* Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and finance teams to ensure accurate budget forecasting and cost tracking
* Develop and maintain project schedules using industry\-standard software, ensuring critical path analysis and resource optimization
* Conduct risk assessments and support risk mitigation planning to protect project objectives
* Train and mentor project team members on controls processes, tools, and best practices
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing controls data and recommending process enhancements

* Advanced proficiency with project management software (MS Project, Primavera P6, Oracle fusion ERP system or equivalent platforms)
* Expert\-level Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis, modeling, and reporting
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail
* Proficiency in budget tracking, cost control, and financial forecasting
* Expertise in schedule development, critical path analysis, and resource planning
* Knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and methodologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational and time management capabilities
* Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments and organizational levels
* Leadership and mentoring skills with the ability to influence without direct authority



 \*\*Required Experience:\*\*
   

  




* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in project controls, project management, or related field
* Proven track record in budget management, cost forecasting, and variance analysis
* Experience developing and maintaining project schedules and performance metrics
* Background in change management and risk management processes
* Experience preparing executive\-level reports and presentations



 \*\*Education \& Certifications:\*\*
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or related discipline
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent (preferred)
* CCP certificate \- Certified Cost Professional certification or similar (preferred)



 \*\*Domain Expertise:\*\*
   

  




* Experience in construction, engineering, or capital project delivery environments
* Familiarity with earned value management systems and integrated project controls
* Knowledge of Saudi Arabia's business environment and regulatory landscape (preferred)
