data.jd_text:
**HEAD OF SCIENCE (Physics or Biology Specialism)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Science (Physics or Biology Specialism)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Science (Physics or Biology Specialism) to lead the Science Department and join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Science. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at NAISAK. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of science performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be, students in classes across the Science will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 Since NAISAK offers a Sixth Form, knowledge of AS/A levels would be an advantage.
   

  

 Finally, you must also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum. You will be preparing students at NAISAK for external examinations at IGSCE, AS \& A Level. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Science, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the Job Description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the English National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced English language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 13,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**Essential**
**EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS SOUGHT**
* University degree in Physics or Biology
* Teaching qualification (QTS ,PGCE/PGDE )
* At least 6 to 9 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum
* Extensive knowledge of the English National curriculum to IGCSE


**Desirable**
* Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
* Master's degree, or other significant professional development
* Previous international experience


**PERSONAL QUALITIES SOUGHT**
* Fluent English speaker
* Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
* Reliability, loyalty and commitment
* Personal confidence and presence
* Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do' approach
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
* Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
* Sense of humour and grace under pressure
* Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
* Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
* Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
* Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 Please apply for this vacancy using our recruitment portal.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application and the details of three professional references.
   

  

**Closing date for applications:** 
 30th June 2026
   

  

**Start date for this role:** 
 1st August 2026
   

  

**Selection Process**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of three professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**Safeguarding**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

**Job Summary**
 The Head of Training Administration leads the design, development and delivery of innovative blended learning solutions that align with organizational competency needs, and compliance requirements, ensuring continuous professional growth and improved business performance.

Additionally, the role holder is charged with sourcing external training solutions and manages external training providers to meet evolving business requirements.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Plan, lead and organize the activities of the Section to ensure that Qafco’s Learning \& Development plans / schedules are met through the optimization and efficient utilization of available manpower, and external training providers.
* Ensure that Sectional staff members are motivated to realize their potential and significantly contribute to the organization.
* Participate in the annual budget preparation process and provide input to the Department Manager.
* Carry out the responsibility of collecting information and workout budget for the Section.
* Continually monitor progress and priorities and make necessary adjustments, where required, to ensure effective cost control.
* Ensure availability of qualified and competent human resources by initiating recruitment, development, and training, where necessary.

* Implement the blended learning models, emphasizing the 10\-20\-10 framework, which encourages integrating formal training and social learning activities.

* Knowledgeable in the design and implementation of competency frameworks

**Project Director – Water Treatment / Desalination – Saudi Arabia** 




 I am working on behalf of a leading organisation delivering some of the Middle East’s most high\-profile water infrastructure programmes, and we are looking to engage an experienced Project Director with a proven track record across large\-scale water treatment and desalination projects in Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 This is a senior leadership opportunity to take ownership of major programmes that sit at the heart of the Kingdom’s long\-term water security and infrastructure strategy.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 You will be responsible for the full lifecycle delivery of complex water and wastewater treatment projects, from early engineering through to commissioning and handover. These are multi\-billion SAR programmes with significant strategic importance, requiring strong leadership across multidisciplinary teams and stakeholder environments.
 



  





 You will play a critical role in driving programme performance, managing risk, and ensuring delivery against cost, schedule and quality expectations within a highly regulated and fast\-paced environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of large\-scale water treatment / desalination projects
* Manage EPC / EPCM contractors and oversee full project execution strategy
* Drive programme governance, reporting, and performance management
* Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations, standards, and client requirements
* Lead and develop high\-performing project teams across engineering, construction, and project controls
* Manage senior stakeholder relationships across client, contractor, and government entities
* Oversee commissioning, testing, and handover phases



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience as Project Director or Senior Project Manager on major water treatment / desalination projects in Saudi Arabia
* Strong background delivering RO plants, wastewater treatment facilities, or large\-scale utilities infrastructure
* Experience working with leading developers / operators such as ACWA Power, Marafiq, SWCC, or similar
* Demonstrated success managing large EPC or EPCM contracts
* Strong commercial, contractual, and project controls understanding
* Ability to lead complex stakeholder environments and deliver under pressure



  





**Salary \& Package** 




 A highly competitive, tax\-efficient salary and comprehensive expatriate package is on offer, designed to reflect the seniority and strategic importance of this role. This typically includes:
 


* Housing allowance or fully provided accommodation
* Annual flights for you and dependents
* Comprehensive medical and life insurance
* Performance\-related bonus aligned to project delivery
* End of service benefits in line with Saudi labour law
* Full relocation and mobilisation support



  





**Why This Role** 




 This is an opportunity to position yourself at the forefront of the Middle East’s infrastructure growth, working on projects that define national development.
 


* Exposure to flagship, high\-value programmes across Saudi Arabia

* Senior leadership role with real influence on project outcomes
* Opportunity to work with some of the most recognised organisations in the region

 Referral recommendations are also welcomed.

**PROJECT MANAGER**
**About TelMAX Inc.**
 Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity\-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21 st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry\-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all\-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.
   

  

**Your Position \& How You Will Contribute**
 Reporting to the Senior Manager, Project Management, the Project Manager will be highly experienced and proactive to lead our Fibre to the Home (FTTH) projects. You will be responsible for developing project plans, predicting and monitoring the progress of all construction and materials acquisition activities, and ensuring successful project delivery on time and within budget. In this highly dynamic position, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in your career and within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Key Duties**
 Project Planning and Management
   

  

* Develop detailed project plans outlining scope, schedule, budget, and resources required.
* Predict, monitor, and control the progress of all construction and materials acquisition activities.
* Ensure that all project phases are completed on time and meet quality standards.


 Coordination and Execution
   

  

* Coordinate with various teams including engineering, construction, procurement, and external vendors.
* Ensure all teams are aligned and working towards the project objectives.
* Oversee the execution of the project plan, adjusting as necessary to meet changing needs and requirements.


 Stakeholder Communication
   

  

* Communicate project status, risks, and issues to key stakeholders, including senior management and clients.
* Prepare and present regular progress reports and updates.
* Facilitate project meetings and follow up on action items.


 Risk Management
   

  

* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Monitor and address issues that may impact project timelines and quality.


 Budget and Resource Management
   

  

* Manage project budgets, ensuring that expenditures are tracked and controlled.
* Allocate resources efficiently and effectively to meet project demands.


 Compliance and Documentation
   

  

* Ensure all project activities comply with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and contracts.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement best practices.
* Conduct post\-project evaluations and lessons learned to enhance future project performance.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Help in setting up the resources and processes (contractors, internal resources)
* Work with contractors to detail specific project deliverables
* Develop timelines of goals and objectives for projects
* Delegating projects to teams best suited to complete them
* Tracking project performance and analyzing deliverables against requirements
* Ensuring that all budgetary objectives are met, adjusting as required
* Creating timely reports for executive committee meetings
* Predicting resource requirements based on build volume
* Scope – Design, Permitting, locates, drilling, fibre blowing, splicing, hand\-over to operations
* Coordination of invoicing from the contractors and ensuring work validation with construction management
* Ensuring the updating of internal systems
* Ensuring the archiving of as\-build drawings


**What You Bring**
* Strong relationship building, judgment skills, problem solving and follow\-up skills
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities
* Ability to maintain confidentiality
* Excellent ability to prioritized and follow through in commitments
* Ability to lead and motivate cross\-functional teams
* Superior level planning and organizing skills, capable of seeing the big picture, understanding system pressures and planning at a detailed level
* Able to tailor your communication style to meet the needs of a variety of audiences, and achieve the desired result
* Comfortable learning new technical systems as needed


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in project management, preferably in the telecommunications industry with a focus on FTTH projects
* Proficiency with project management tools and software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera, Smartsheet)
* Strong understanding of construction and materials acquisition processes
* Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy and resourceful mindset
* Excellent organizational skills
* Strong time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple on\-going priorities
* Ability to handle confidential and non\-routine information with discretion and professionalism
* Highly professional and diplomatic, with a very positive disposition
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Ability to take initiative and work under pressure with minimal supervision
* Natural interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work effectively and prioritize tasks.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn and adapt.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in project management, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field
* Experience in related areas or fields
* PMP or PRINCE2 certification is a plus
* College or University degree in related field


**ImPACT Values**
* Performance \& Commitment


 We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.
   

  

* Agility \& Collaboration


 We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.
   

  

* Customer Centricity


 In every decision we make, we think through the customer’s lens. We know that anticipating and exceeding their expectations isn’t just good service—it’s the foundation of who we are. By staying deeply connected to our customers’ needs, we build loyalty, enhance our reputation, spark positive word\-of\-mouth and drive company growth.
   

  

* Trust \& Integrity


 We build trust by acting with integrity, respect, and transparency in everything we do. We communicate with each other openly and presume positive intentions. By upholding these principles, we strengthen relationships, create a culture of respect, and empower teams to succeed together.
   

  

**Why You Should Join TelMAX**
* We are a growing, dynamic organization

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a
 **Project Manager \- Credit Card Migration to join a well\-known Islamic Bank in Bahrain.** 
 The Ideal candidate will lead and deliver end\-to\-end credit card system and/or portfolio migration initiatives, ensuring successful execution across scope, time, budget, quality, and operational readiness. Own the migration governance, planning, stakeholder coordination, execution, cutover, and post go\-live stabilization while ensuring accurate data reconciliation and business sign\-off.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\) Project Governance \& Delivery Management** 



* Define and apply an appropriate project management framework and delivery governance (steering, working groups, RAID, milestones, reporting cadence) to ensure completion within agreed scope, quality, and timelines.
* Prepare the project brief/charter and initiation documentation; establish clear scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage scope changes through structured change control; drive decisions and approvals in a timely manner.
* Manage project risks/issues and ensure mitigation plans are actively owned and executed.



**2\) Credit Card Migration Planning \& Execution** 



* Own the end\-to\-end migration approach for new Credit Card system setup and/or system/portfolio migration, including strategy, sequencing, trial conversions, and final migration execution.
* Lead the planning and execution of parallel run and cutover planning.
* Lead data reconciliation and business sign\-off activities.
* Manage migration of account, card, transaction, installment, and fee data.
* Ensure readiness for authorization, clearing, billing, settlement, and collections flows.
* Ensure migration readiness across business, operations, technology, and vendors, including runbooks, cutover checklists, and rollback considerations.



**3\) Testing \& Environment Readiness (SIT/UAT/Parallel Run)** 



* Plan and manage SIT, UAT, and Parallel Run activities end\-to\-end, including test strategy, scope, entry/exit criteria, defect triage, and governance.
* Coordinate business users for UAT execution and sign\-off.
* Drive closure of defects, gaps, and reconciliation breaks prior to go\-live.



**4\) Data Migration, Reconciliation \& Controls** 



* Lead the data migration lifecycle: strategy, mapping, extraction, transformation, loading, trial runs, and reconciliation.
* Establish reconciliation controls and sign\-off packs between old and new systems.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness for key datasets and balances; drive resolution of discrepancies.



**5\) Scheme \& Platform / Vendor Coordination** 



* Work effectively with CMS platforms (VisionPLUS) and associated vendors/partners, ensuring delivery alignment, integration readiness, and clear responsibilities (RACI).
* Ensure the migration scope covers Visa/Mastercard data and scheme\-related flows in alignment with business requirements and operational cutover needs.



**6\) Shariah\-Compliant Product Considerations (Preferred)** 



* Ensure the solution and migration approach supports Shariah\-compliant card structures, preferably Tawarruq/Murabaha\-based settlement and profit calculation rules.
* Coordinate requirements validation and sign\-offs with relevant product owners and compliance stakeholders as applicable.



**7\) Go\-Live Command Center \& Hypercare** 



* Lead the cutover and go\-live command center, including war\-room governance, tracking, and escalation management.
* Lead post go\-live hypercare, ensuring issue triage, prioritization, resolution tracking, and stabilization closure with formal acceptance.



**Required Knowledge \& Experience (Must Have)**

**Reimagine What’s Possible**
 Job Description and Qualifications
   

  

 Rotoflow™, an Air Products Business, is a full\-service turbomachinery OEM \- providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and services to our customers globally in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Aftermarket services such as spare parts, repairs, upgrades, field services, engineering evaluations, reliability and performance assessments, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, and shop services are some of the many offerings provided from regional service centers for both Air Products and non\-Air Products equipment.
   

  

 We are seeking an
 **Rotoflow** 
**Aftermarket Project Manager** 
 at our turbomachinery service center in KSA\- DSC, responsible for providing projects execution with engineering support for spare parts, repairs, upgrades, reverse engineering, and field service of all types of turbomachinery.

* Lead and guide the execution team and provide directions on objective priorities to ensure tasks and deliverables are completed as planned.
* Manage changes on projects to keep projects on track and meet financial and customer targets.

* Goal oriented, self\-motivated, highly organized, with ability to drive success, with strong winning spirit and ability to motivate teams.
* Excellent creativity, problem solving, and decision\-making skills \- including an understanding of when to escalate both technical and administrative decisions.
* Aptitude and desire to quickly learn.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Ability and drive to continuously improve and eliminate unnecessary barriers or complexity to meeting customer needs

 We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. data.jd_text:
**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Head of Sales** 
 will be responsible for building and scaling the commercial engine of a new industrial chemicals trading and distribution business in Saudi Arabia. The role owns revenue delivery, gross margin management, key account acquisition, and commercial governance (pricing and credit discipline). The incumbent will lead a dedicated sales team, institutionalize a robust sales process—including CRM integration and forecasting—and ensure the business achieves its strategic growth targets while maintaining service reliability and risk\-managed working capital.
 



  





**Strategic Objectives** 




**Execution outcomes for the growth phase:** 



* **Market Penetration:** 
 Establish a robust base of active, repeat\-ordering customers across priority industrial segments.
* **Pipeline Health:** 
 Maintain a healthy pipeline\-to\-target ratio to ensure consistent revenue growth.
* **Profitability:** 
 Achieve targeted gross margins through disciplined pricing and segment\-specific strategies.
* **Credit Governance:** 
 Ensure controlled credit growth with rigorous collection discipline and DSO management.
* **Supply Partnerships:** 
 Secure and manage strategic relationships with global manufacturers and master distributors.



  





**Industrial Segment Focus** 




**Phase I (Primary Focus)** 



* **Surface Coatings \& Performance Materials:** 
 Raw materials and specialized inputs for industrial applications.
* **Water Management \& Process Chemicals:** 
 Consumables and project supply for industrial and service contractors.
* **Construction \& Infrastructure Chemicals:** 
 Specialized additives and raw materials for large\-scale infrastructure.
* **Mining \& Mineral Processing:** 
 Selective pursuit of process chemicals and grinding media for the cement and mining industries.



  





**Phase II (Regulatory Expansion)** 



* **Food \& Nutrition Ingredients:** 
 Development of the compliance pathway for food and animal feed\-related inputs.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Revenue Delivery \& Market Penetration** 



* Own and deliver annual sales targets with a clear, segment\-wise execution plan.
* Identify and convert a prioritized list of strategic accounts into active, long\-term partners.
* Establish a repeatable sales cadence: from prospecting and technical sampling to final approval and annual agreements.



**Key Account \& Strategic Relationship Management** 



* Personally lead senior\-level engagement with procurement heads, plant managers, and R\&D/QC leadership.
* Map customer decision processes, bridging the gap between technical approval and commercial execution.
* Negotiate framework agreements and secure preferred supplier status with Tier\-1 accounts.



**Commercial Governance: Pricing \& Credit Discipline** 



* Own the pricing strategy and execute disciplined quotation management.
* Monitor profitability by customer and segment; implement corrective actions such as mix optimization or alternate sourcing.
* Partner with finance to enforce credit limits and collection rhythms, ensuring growth is cash\-responsible.



**Portfolio Strategy \& Principal Development** 



* Define and manage the portfolio across
 **stock\-and\-sell** 
 (fast movers) and
 **back\-to\-back** 
 import models.
* Identify and onboard new suppliers, negotiating commercial terms, territories, and technical support.
* Implement principal management discipline, including demand forecasting and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).



**Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Lead and coach the sales team, setting clear territories, activity KPIs, and performance standards.
* Drive a high\-performance culture focused on activity metrics, conversion rates, and disciplined execution.



  





**Candidate Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 10\+ years in B2B sales and business development within industrial chemicals distribution/trading, specifically in Saudi Arabia or the GCC.
* **Track Record:** 
 Proven success in "door opening" at strategic accounts and managing the technical selling cycle (trials/approvals).
* **Leadership:** 
 Experience managing direct reports and building sales team capabilities.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Strong competence in pricing, contract negotiation, and credit\-aware selling.
* **Technical Knowledge:** 
 Familiarity with industry\-standard documentation (SDS, COA) and chemical storage/logistics constraints.
* 
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or Business.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluency in English is required; Arabic is strongly preferred.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* **Revenue \& Profitability:** 
 Revenue vs. plan and contribution margin by segment.
* **Conversion Metrics:** 
 Quote\-to\-order and trial\-to\-approval conversion rates.
* **Pipeline Management:** 
 Pipeline value, stage conversion, and forecast accuracy.
* **Financial Health:** 
 DSO, overdue percentages, and collection effectiveness.
* **Supply Chain:** 
 Number of quality supply relationships onboarded and product line launch success.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 A KSA\-based industrial commercial leader who has successfully built revenue streams from the ground up. You are a
 **"player\-coach"** 
 —capable of opening doors with senior stakeholders while maintaining the discipline required for pricing, collections, and CRM rigor. You are comfortable in a lean, execution\-driven environment and possess the social intelligence to navigate complex technical and commercial landscapes.

data.jd_text:
**Be Part of a Legacy Bigger Than the Game**




 At
 **Al\-Qadsiah Club** 
 we create more than teams! We’re crafting a legacy that goes beyond the game, making an impact both on and off the field. Driven by ambition, synergy, and innovation, we aim to inspire generations while shaping the future of Saudi sports.
   





 This is more than just a job! It’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
   

  




**Overview:**

 The Head of Ticketing \& Memberships is responsible for the strategic leadership, performance and development of the end\-to\-end Al Qadsiah Club ticketing \& memberships function. The role ensures that ticketing activity maximizes income and attendance, supports audience and membership growth, delivers excellent customer \& fan experience and provides high\-quality data and insight to inform organizational decision making. This role provides oversight of pricing, sales channels, CRM (shared responsibility with Head of Digital) and audience insight, while overseeing day\-to\-day operational delivery and acts as the organization’s senior authority on ticketing and data governance systems and sales performance.
   

  

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Collaborate with the CCO to develop and implement the Club’s ticketing \& membership strategy in alignment with organizational priorities, revenue targets, and audience development goals, building on the growth and learnings from the past 2 seasons.
* Manage tickets, memberships and experiences pricing, discounting, and yield strategies to balance revenue generation, accessibility, and audience growth.
* Working closely with the Aramco Stadium Team, monitor ticket sales performance against targets, forecast revenue, and adjust pricing or inventory strategies in response to demand and market trends.
* Oversee all ticketing systems, CRM platforms, and third\-party integrations to ensure effective configuration, data integrity, and operational efficiency across events and sales channels.
* Manage all events on sales processes, including CRM setup and ticket inventory configuration, ensuring accuracy and operational readiness.
* Ensure a high standard of customer experience across all ticketing and box\-office operations by establishing and maintaining customer service standards.
* Maintain, amend and enforce ticketing policies and procedures, including refunds, exchanges, discounts, and accessibility provisions, ensuring consistency and compliance.
* Utilize CRM and ticketing data to generate insights that support reporting, marketing initiatives, and audience development strategies.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and organizational policies related to customer data management within the ticketing function.


* Lead and develop the ticketing \& memberships team by providing clear direction, performance management, training, and operational oversight to ensure efficient service delivery.


 Requirements
   

  

* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, Sports Management, or related field is preferred.


* **Experience:** 
 5\-7 years in ticketing, box office operations and/or CRM leadership (ideally within a sports/entertainment venue environment)
* **Skills:**



 \- Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to drive revenue through pricing strategies, yield management, and sales optimization across multiple channels.
   





 \- Data\-Driven Decision Making: Advanced capability in interpreting ticketing and CRM data to generate actionable insights, forecast demand, and influence strategy.
   





 \- CRM \& Ticketing Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of ticketing platforms and CRM ecosystems, including segmentation, automation, and customer lifecycle management.
   





 \- Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate organizational goals into scalable ticketing and membership strategies that drive both short\-term revenue and long\-term fan growth.
   





 \- Leadership \& Team Management: Proven experience in leading, developing, and scaling high\-performing teams with clear KPIs and accountability frameworks.
   





 \- Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration skills with senior leadership, media, operations, and external partners to align commercial objectives.
   





 \- Customer Experience Orientation: Understanding of fan behavior and expectations, with the ability to design seamless, high\-quality end\-to\-end customer journeys.
   





 \- Financial \& Forecasting Skills: Strong budgeting, forecasting, and revenue tracking capabilities.
   





  




* **Preferred Experience \& Qualifications:**



 \- Experience within a professional sports club, major entertainment venue, or large\-scale event organization.
   





 \- Proven track record of driving ticketing revenue growth and increasing attendance in a competitive market.
   





 \- Experience implementing or optimizing CRM strategies tied to fan engagement, memberships, and retention.
   





 \- Experience working in high\-growth or transformation environments, where systems, processes, and strategies are being built or scaled.
   





 \- Master’s degree in business, Sports Management, or a related field is a plus.
   

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  


**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?**



* **Be Part of the Legacy:** 
 Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
* **Experience the Culture:** 
 Thrive in an environment that values
 **quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony** 
 . This is the Qadsiah Way.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines
 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality** 
 , ensuring that systems are built to high standards of reliability, performance, and maintainability.
   

  

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the
 **executional deputy** 
 , translating those strategic objectives into code, architecture, and delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.
* Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring systems are built to last while meeting immediate needs.
* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Delivery and Alignment: Partner with the Head of Engineering to own delivery of entire work\-streams, ensuring architecture and engineering decisions align with both immediate requirements and business strategy.
* Balance Code and Leadership: Contribute directly through coding, while also focusing on architecture design, peer reviews, and cross\-functional communication.
* Mentor and Elevate Engineers: Provide structured feedback through design and code reviews, support skill development, and empower junior and mid\-level engineers to take ownership.
* Technical Leadership: Guide system design, ensure scalability and resilience, and optimise performance across applications and infrastructure.
* Maintain Standards: Uphold engineering best practices, enforce coding guidelines, and partner with QA to embed automation and validation in the delivery pipeline.
* Codebase Health: Manage technical debt, lead refactoring initiatives, and ensure long\-term maintainability and operational excellence.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to define scope, refine requirements, and plan delivery in a transparent and predictable manner.
* Risk Management: Anticipate technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and propose mitigations to safeguard delivery timelines.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years in a Technical Leadership position guiding teams, shaping architecture, and driving delivery of complex projects
* Demonstrated expertise in architecting and maintaining high\-concurrency, low\-latency trading systems at scale
* Advanced proficiency in Rust; working knowledge of Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Python is an advantage
* Deep experience with data\-intensive architectures and real\-time data pipelines
* Proven track record deploying, optimising and operating AWS environments for ultra\-low\-latency workloads
* Hands\-on experience containerising applications and managing Kubernetes clusters in production
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments
* Solid command of software engineering best practices, including Agile methodologies, DevOps principles and end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of DevSecFinOps principles to embed security, compliance and cost\-governance throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Ownership \& Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high\-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
* Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
* Curiosity \& Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
* Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or freelancer).
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non\-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.
   

  

 https://keyrock.com/careers/

data.raw_snippet:

 To support the Department’s strong foundation, fostering an environment of excellence, innovation and continuous enhancement to support the delivery of a high\-quality Medicine programme at RCSI Bahrain. Champion academic standards and drive the implementation and continuous improve
data.jd_text:
**Objective:** 
 To support the Department’s strong foundation, fostering an environment of excellence, innovation and continuous enhancement to support the delivery of a high\-quality Medicine programme at RCSI Bahrain. Champion academic standards and drive the implementation and continuous improvement of the curriculum, aligned with best practice and ensure the effective delivery of the undergraduate teaching programme in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology, promoting a culture of collaboration, research engagement and academic development across the School.
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Department of Obstetrics \& Gynaecology
   

  

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Academic Leadership \& Governance:**
* Provide academic leadership for the Department of Obstetrics \& Gynaecology, ensuring excellence in teaching, assessment, research, and clinical integration.
* Be accountable, through established University management and governance structures, for the delivery of all academic commitments associated with the post.
* Support in the design, development, delivery, review, and continuous improvement of undergraduate and postgraduate Obstetrics \& Gynaecology curricula, modules, and assessments.
* Ensure alignment of departmental activities with national and international standards of medical education and training, including Medical Council requirements.
* Contribute to University\-wide academic planning, quality assurance, accreditation processes, and academic policy development as required.


**Teaching and Training:**
* Contribute to clinical and campus\-based teaching across junior, intermediate, and senior cycles of the medical programme.
* Effective delivery of teaching and training at relevant clinical sites, including responsibility for undergraduate learners.
* Provide academic leadership in student assessment, including examination design, standard setting, delivery, evaluation, and feedback processes.
* Support academic and clinical faculty within the department, fostering excellence in teaching and professional development.
* Ensure appropriate use of the virtual learning environment to support teaching, communication, and student engagement.


**Clinical Leadership and Integration:**
* Support in the clinical component of the post as ensuring integration between academic objectives and clinical service delivery.
* Work collaboratively with Clinical Directors and hospital partners to ensure high\-quality Obstetrics \& Gynaecology training and service provision.
* Undertake clinical duties within designated teaching hospitals, with scope and commitment defined in agreement with relevant governance structures.
* Promote best practice in patient care, teaching, and supervision within clinical settings.


**Research and Scholarly Activity:**
* Provide support in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology research for departmental research strategy, grant activity, and scholarly output.
* Supervise faculty, trainees, and students in research activities.
* Contribute to the advancement of Obstetrics \& Gynaecology knowledge through research, publication, and academic collaboration.


**Strategic Development and External Engagement:**
* Play a key role in the development and reform of medical education, training, and research, aligned with Government policy and institutional strategy.
* Collaborate across University and clinical sites, and with postgraduate bodies, regulatory authorities, and professional organisations, on international, national, and regional initiatives.

It is an opportunity to influence education at scale in a mission\-driven, impact\-oriented environment.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Define and lead the strategic vision for multi\-year professional learning programs across districts, schools, and grade levels, ensuring alignment across curriculum, instruction, leadership development, and assessment systems.

* Deep expertise in secondary mathematics education (grades 3\-12\), including math content knowledge, pedagogical content knowledge, and instructional practice.
* Strong ability to translate educational research into scalable, multi\-year learning designs and systems.

 Technical Project Manager\- Post Merger Integration

 Business Head\- Retail Banking

 Minimum 10 years in project/ programme management; minimum 5 years in retail banking M\&A/ PMI
   

  

**Mandatory requirements:**
* Proven, hands\-on retail bank merger integration experience (Day 1 readiness through post\-merger stabilisation)
* Experience operating or establishing an Integration Management Office (IMO)
* English Fluency (\& Arabic Preferred)
* Immediately Available


**Purpose of Project:**
 As part of the retail bank merger, this role is responsible for owning and managing all technology and technical product elements of the integration programme. The Technical Product Manager bridges the gap between business integration objectives and technical execution — defining the technology roadmap, managing system integration work streams, and ensuring seamless delivery of core banking, digital, and data migration components across the merging entities.
   

  

**Key Activities:**
* Own the technology integration roadmap from discovery through to live cutover and post\-migration stabilisation
* Lead API mapping, system architecture design, and integration specifications across all platforms
* Manage core banking system integration, digital channel consolidation, data migration, and infrastructure cutover
* Coordinate with engineering teams, technology vendors, and business work stream leads to align technical deliverables to programme milestones
* Define and maintain integration playbooks, API specifications, technical run books, and cutover plans \[jobs.dcg.co]
* Monitor system performance (latency, reliability, transaction integrity) during and post\-integration


**Core Responsibilities:**
* Technology Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership — Define, own, and execute the technology integration strategy and product roadmap, aligning to the merger's business objectives, regulatory requirements, and IT architecture standards. Prioritise technology workstreams to maximise integration velocity and minimise customer disruption.
* Core Banking \& System Integration — Lead the integration of core banking platforms, digital channels, payment systems, and data infrastructure across the two merging entities. Manage vendor relationships with core banking providers, ensuring timely certifications and technical sign\-off at each integration milestone.
* Product Lifecycle Management (SDLC) — Drive end\-to\-end product delivery using Agile and SDLC best practices — from requirements gathering and technical design, through development, UAT, and live deployment. Maintain integration backlogs, sprint plans, and release schedules in tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Technical Communication — Act as the primary liaison between senior business stakeholders, engineering teams, IT vendors, and Compliance/Legal. Translate complex technical dependencies into business\-friendly language for SteerCo and executive audiences.
* Data Migration \& Quality Assurance — Oversee end\-to\-end data migration strategy, including data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, and post migration validation. Ensure data integrity and regulatory compliance (GDPR, local data residency laws) throughout.
* Risk, Performance \& Continuous Improvement — Identify, assess, and mitigate technology risks (integration failures, system downtime, data loss). Monitor live integration performance metrics and iterate rapidly to resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and SLA adherence post\-cutover.


**KPIs**
* % of technology milestones delivered on schedule and within budget
* System uptime and availability during cutover windows (target: 99\.9%\+)
* Data migration accuracy rate (target: 100% reconciled with zero data loss)
* Number of integration defects / severity\-1 incidents post\-cutover
* API integration delivery timelines vs. plan
* Time to complete core banking system cutover vs. target
* Business stakeholder satisfaction with technical delivery (SteerCo rating)


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 8\+ years of product management or technology delivery experience in fintech, banking, or financial services
* 3\+ years leading integrations with banks, payment processors, or core financial systems \[tealhq.com]
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of core banking platforms (e.g., Temenos T24, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finacle, Mambu, Fiserv, Jack Henry)
* Expertise in payment rails: SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, RTP, and local real\-time payment schemes
* Experience with data architecture, pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices \[jobs.anitab.org]
* Experience working in regulated banking environments — familiar with regulatory technology requirements and compliance obligations during system transitions


**Mandatory Skills\*\***
* Proven experience managing technology integration workstreams in a banking M\&A or large\-scale transformation context
* Hands\-on technical fluency with core banking platforms, APIs, and system architecture
* Track record of end\-to\-end product lifecycle management in regulated financial environments
* Familiarity with payment rails (SWIFT, ACH, local real\-time payment schemes), data migration, and digital channel consolidation
* Agile/SAFe certified (PMI\-ACP or equivalent); TOGAF or ITIL

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Commercial Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of complex projects, targeting candidates with a strong background in finance and project management. You will work on meaningful projects that shape the future of energy, ensuring commercial, financial, and contractual objectives are met, thereby contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions. Your work will have a significant impact on the team, clients, and partners, fostering a collaborative culture that values innovation, integrity, and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Collaborate with the Project Manager to deliver projects within agreed commercial, financial, time, and quality targets, ensuring customer satisfaction throughout the project life cycle.
* Coordinate with customers, suppliers, and internal departments to facilitate effective project execution and maintain strong relationships.
* Manage and control project financial performance, including orders, revenue, costs, profit, cash flow, receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital, aligning with budget and forecast.
* Support monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, controlling, and financial reporting activities to ensure accurate and timely financial insights.
* Drive optimization of project profitability, cash flow, and Net Capital Employed, maintaining a focus on financial health and sustainability.
* Ensure compliance with Siemens Energy policies, contractual terms, financial reporting guidelines, and local regulations, managing contracts, claims, and risk and opportunity topics.


**What You Bring**
* A university degree in Accounting, Finance, International Business, or related financial areas, providing a solid foundation for commercial project management.
* 3–5 years of experience in project controlling, commercial project management, or a comparable role, demonstrating a proven track record in managing complex projects.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS 15 and financial closing processes, ensuring adherence to international financial standards.
* Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications, enabling efficient management of project data and communication.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, fostering collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Ability to maintain audit\-ready documentation and support internal/external audits, ensuring transparency and accountability in project execution.


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**




 We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Lighting Sales Manager with a strong background in managing medium and large\-scale lighting projects across Kuwait. The ideal candidate will have well\-established relationships with engineering consultants, main contractors, and end clients, and will be capable of leading a sales team while personally driving key account development. You will take ownership of the full project sales cycle — from early specification influence through to order closure and delivery coordination.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Sales Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Develop and execute a structured sales strategy for lighting projects aligned with the company's annual revenue targets and growth objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the lighting sales team, setting individual targets and conducting regular performance reviews.
* Report weekly and monthly project pipeline status and sales performance directly to the Managing Director.



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key engineering consultants, MEP contractors, main contractors, interior designers, and project owners across Kuwait.
* Conduct regular client visits, site surveys, and design\-stage meetings to influence lighting specifications in favour of the company's portfolio.
* Act as a senior point of contact for key accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business.



**Technical \& Commercial Sales** 



* Prepare and present detailed technical proposals, lighting design concepts, and commercial quotations tailored to project requirements and budgets.
* Review tender documents, BOQs, and consultant specifications to ensure correct product selection and full compliance.
* Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and supply agreements with clients, contractors, and manufacturers to close orders profitably.
* Collaborate with manufacturer representatives and technical teams to deliver customised lighting solutions, mock\-ups, and value\-engineering alternatives.



**Project Execution \& Coordination** 



* Oversee order handling, delivery scheduling, and documentation (product data sheets, photometric reports, warranties, and certifications) to ensure on\-time project delivery.
* Monitor active projects to ensure alignment with client timelines, budget constraints, and technical specifications.
* Resolve post\-sale technical issues and coordinate with suppliers to manage warranties, replacements, and site support.



**Market Intelligence \& Business Development** 



* Identify and pursue new project opportunities in commercial, hospitality, retail, government, healthcare, and infrastructure segments across Kuwait.
* Conduct ongoing market research to track competitor activity, new project awards, and emerging lighting technology trends.
* Evaluate and expand the company's lighting product portfolio in response to market demand and project requirements.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements**



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline (preferred).
* Minimum 8 years of lighting project sales experience in Kuwait, with a demonstrated track record of managing medium and large\-scale projects from specification to delivery.
* Strong existing network of relationships with engineering consultants, MEP contractors, and procurement decision\-makers in the Kuwait market.
* Proficiency in lighting design and calculation software (DIALux, Relux, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.
* Solid commercial acumen with experience in tender preparation, BOQ analysis, and contract negotiation.
* Prior experience in a managerial or team\-lead sales capacity.
* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English
* Valid Kuwait driving licence; must be based in Kuwait with a transferable residency visa.

**Purpose / Mission:**
 Lead and direct the in\-country owner's project team through pre\-FID, FEED, EPC award, construction and commissioning of a greenfield 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant in Duqm, Oman. Accountable for engineering definition, cost estimate accuracy, schedule integrity, HSE performance, contractor management, and all local stakeholder and authority interfaces required to deliver the project on time, on budget and to the required quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead the in\-country owner's project team, providing day\-to\-day direction and decision\-making authority across all project workstreams.
* Direct and manage the Owner's Engineer (OE) and EPC contractors across the DRI/HBI process plant, Balance of Plant, and Materials Handling packages, ensuring scope, schedule, cost and quality are delivered against contractual commitments.
* Own and drive the project master schedule, including interdependencies between engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, utility connections and port readiness.
* Own the project cost estimate to a level of accuracy sufficient to support Final Investment Decision and lender due diligence.
* Represent the Company in\-country with all host country authorities, port development partners, utility providers, industrial zone authorities, and other project counterparties.
* Provide HSE leadership and ensure HSE performance standards are embedded into engineering, procurement and construction practices, in line with international best practice and local regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with the Group Chief Executive, VP Projects \& Sustainability, and Director Global Projects on strategic direction, risk management, and stakeholder reporting.
* Support the Company in its engagements with project finance lenders, independent technical advisors, and equity investors, including participation in technical due diligence exercises.
* Manage the interfaces between the process technology licensor, the OE, and the EPC contractors to deliver integrated plant design and operational readiness.
* Lead the in\-country growth of the project team from pre\-FID into construction execution, including recruitment, onboarding and development of a high\-performing, multi\-disciplinary organization.


**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
* Minimum 20 years' experience in major capital projects in heavy industry, with project director\-level accountability on at least one greenfield plant of capex value USD 500 million or above.
* Direct experience in integrated steel, Direct Reduced Iron (DRI), ironmaking, or analogous gas\-based process plants is strongly preferred. Experience in petrochemical, fertilizer, ammonia or methanol megaprojects will be considered.
* Demonstrated accountability across the full project lifecycle: feasibility, FEED, EPC tender and award, construction, commissioning and early operations.
* Proven ability to manage multi\-package EPC programs with separate technology, balance of plant, materials handling and civil contractors.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including FIDIC\-based EPC contracts, PMC arrangements, and owner's engineer structures.
* Middle East or GCC project delivery experience strongly preferred. Prior experience in Oman is an advantage.
* Demonstrated capability to work effectively with project finance lenders, independent engineers, and institutional investors.
* Ability to hold an independent professional position with senior executives and shareholders where the project's success requires it.
* Strong leadership and people development skills, with experience building multicultural, multi\-disciplinary project teams from the ground up.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills at board, government and community levels.


**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Metallurgical, or equivalent Engineering discipline (required).
* Master's degree in Engineering or a Master's in Business Administration (preferred).
* Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer or equivalent internationally recognized professional status (preferred).
* Member of a recognized professional engineering institution (e.g. IMechE, IChemE, AIST, SME) (preferred).


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

**About the Role** 









 The
 **Service Operations Manager** 
 is based in Oman and is responsible for leading and driving the overall service operations performance across the country. The role focuses on delivering operational excellence, achieving revenue and profitability targets, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction across all service segments, including maintenance, repairs, spare parts, and retrofit projects.
 



  





 This position plays a critical role in managing service delivery through internal teams and Authorized Service Providers (ASPs), optimizing resources, and strengthening operational processes. The role also supports business growth by closely aligning with service sales, enhancing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations, and ISO management systems.
 



  





**How You Will Make an Impact** 




  




* Report directly to the Service Director and take full responsibility for Service Operations across Oman.
* Drive revenue growth and profitability by ensuring operational excellence, cost control, and efficient execution of service activities.
* Lead, develop, and coach the operations team to achieve business targets, including revenue, margin, collections, and cost management.
* Conduct regular operational reviews, including bids, quotations, contracts, and estimates to ensure accuracy and competitiveness.
* Establish and enforce operational discipline through standardized tools, processes, and performance management.
* Act as a key member of the DAOM leadership team, providing regular performance updates and strategic inputs.
* Monitor, analyze, and improve the performance of operations teams, ASPs, contractors, and third\-party manpower.
* Ensure timely execution and invoicing of service jobs to meet monthly revenue recognition targets.
* Drive key service KPIs such as response time, first\-time fix rate, and customer satisfaction.
* Support service sales by generating leads for AMC, OMC, T\&M, spare parts, and replacement opportunities.
* Plan and manage operational budgets, manpower, and resources to support current operations and future growth.
* Develop and strengthen the ASP network, ensuring proper contracts, performance tracking, and payment structures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, dealers, and service partners.
* Handle and resolve escalated service issues, ensuring timely closure and high customer satisfaction.
* Communicate regularly with DAOM management and regional teams on service performance, profitability, and improvements.
* Oversee performance management and development of the service operations team.
* Monitor job progress and ensure timely closure of pending service activities.
* Coordinate closely with spare parts teams to ensure availability of materials and minimize service delays.
* Oversee spare parts operations, including planning and inventory management for internal and external customers.

* Act as a single point of contact for the various business areas in Oman Branch to enhance customer experience, manage customer expectations and achieve customer satisfaction.
* Lead the development and execution of the IT strategy for FAB Oman, ensuring alignment with Group objectives and regulatory requirements.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 





 IT Strategy
 



* Contribute to the development of technology strategies and roadmap in alignment with Head Office’s global strategy in tandem with the needs of the branch.

 IT Operations
 



* Ensure all the IT hardware and applications in OMAN branches are running/functioning well within the agreed SLA.
* Monitor all IT issues and ensure timely closure of these issues.
* Conduct the IT assessments for all new or existing systems, where required and applicable
* Manage and report all serious IT incidents, including providing root cause analysis and remedial actions to be taken.
* Ensure all IT documentations are up to date
* Ensure all IT activities including changes to existing systems and implementation of new systems/ processes are in compliance with HO Policy and local regulations.
* Support and undertake all disaster recovery activities for primary and DR sites conduicted by Head Office and/or branch
* Proper maintenance of a comprehensive inventory listing for all IT assets
* Manage the OMAN IT vendors and responsible for the effective oversight of the technology service providers to FAB OMAN




 Leadership Management
 



* Accountable for and have direct oversight over a team of IT employees, including those from outsource service providers
* oversee resource allocation plan to ensure appropriate balance between tactical and strategic demands, staff development plan, staff appraisals and feedback.
* Identify and develop key talent and ensure proper succession/back\-up plan is in place
* Oversee OMAN branches annual budget.
* Manage and control the branch’s annual IT budget and expenditure by ensuring proper costs recording, classification of costs, timely accruals and produce variance reporting.
* Provide advice to Senior Management on all IT related laws, regulations and guidelines and their implications to the branch.
* Provide resolution to Senior Management on all IT\-related issues or problems.




 Information and Cyber Security
 



* Proactively address the external threat environment for emerging threats, data breaches, IT security breaches, and implement the appropriate courses of action, including timely patching for vulnerabilities

 IT Governance and Compliance
 



* Accountable for all aspects of IT Governance, Risk Management and Compliance by ensuring there is adequate business and systems controls in place for addressing business/regulatory data and IT compliance, for CBOregulations/notices. This is in addition to ensuring adequate procedures/processes are in place for continuous monitoring of both internal and outsourced/managed services vendor environments.
* Ensure compliance to IT polices, processes, Information security policy and local regulations
* Full ownership and accountability for IT audit, RCSA (Risk Profiles) and other 3rd assurance reviews and ensure risk remediation in timely manner




 Procurement and Project Management
 



* Accountable for procurement of all IT equipment upon consultation/direction from Head Office in Oman branch and ensure proper oversight on the technology procuremg in OMAN branches

* Ensure all change management activities are carried out orderly, including changes to existing systems and implementation of new systems / processes are in compliance with HO Policy and local regulations, testing have being conducted with results properly validated and documentation/training have been shared with staff
* Accountable for the overall successful delivery of projects by overseeing the delivery to ensure that IT solutions implemented fulfil branch’s needs.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 



* Master’s or Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related qualification
* Certification in Cloud , Project Management Professional (PMP), COBIT, CISSP and/or other relevant technical certifications will be an advantage
* At least 12 years of relevant work experience in banking Business and technology services , IT infrastructure and operations, inclusive of at least 5 years’ experience in leading and managing employees.
* Good track record in IT strategy development, solution design, programme and project delivery and service management.

**Job title:** 
 Manager, Geoscience
